book_of_jubilees.t: And he prepared the kid first, and placed some of its blood on the flesh that was on the altar which he had made, and all the fat he laid on the altar where he made the burnt sacrifice, and the ox and the ram and the sheep, and he laid all their flesh upon the altar.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And he placed all their offerings mingled with oil upon it, and afterwards he sprinkled wine on the fire which he had previously made on the altar, and he placed incense on the altar and caused a sweet savour to ascend acceptable before the Lord his God.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And he rejoiced and drank of this wine, he and his children with joy.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And it was evening, and he went into his tent, and being drunken he lay down and slept, and was uncovered in his tent as he slept.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ham saw Noah his father naked, and went forth and told his two brethren without.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And Shem took his garment and arose, he and Japheth, and they placed the garment on their shoulders and went backward and covered the shame of their father, and their faces were backward.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And Noah awoke from his sleep and knew all that his younger son had done unto him, and he cursed his son and said: “Cursed be Canaan; an enslaved servant shall he be unto his brethren.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And he blessed Shem, and said: “Blessed be the Lord God of Shem, and Canaan shall be his servant.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: God shall enlarge Japheth, and God shall dwell in the dwelling of Shem, and Canaan shall be his servant.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ham knew that his father had cursed his younger son, and he was displeased that he had cursed his son, and he parted from his father, he and his sons with him, Cush and Mizraim and Put and Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And he built for himself a city and called its name after the name of his wife Nê’êlâtamâ’ûk.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And Japheth saw it, and became envious of his brother, and he too built for himself a city, and he called its name after the name of his wife ‘Adâtanêsês.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And Shem dwelt with his father Noah, and he built a city close to his father on the mountain, and he too called its name after the name of his wife Sêdêqêtêlĕbâb.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And behold these three cities are near Mount Lûbâr; Sêdêqêtêlĕbâb fronting the mountain on its east; and Na’êlâtamâ’ûk on the south; ‘Adatanêsês towards the west.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And these are the sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad--this (son) was born two years after the flood--and Lud, and Aram.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan, Tubal and Meshech and Tiras: these are the sons of Noah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the twenty-eighth jubilee Noah began to enjoin upon his sons ’ sons (1324-1372 A.M.) the ordinances and commandments, and all the judgments that he knew, and he exhorted his sons to observe righteousness, and to cover the shame of their flesh, and to bless their Creator, and honour father and mother, and love their neighbour, and guard their souls from fornication and uncleanness and all iniquity.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: For owing to these three things came the flood upon the earth, namely, owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And they begat sons the Nâphîdîm, and †they were all unlike†, and they devoured one another: and the Giants slew the Nâphîl, and the Nâphîl slew the Eljô, and the Eljô mankind, and one man another.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And every one sold himself to work iniquity and to shed much blood, and the earth was filled with iniquity.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And after this they sinned against the beasts and birds, and all that moveth and walketh on the earth: and much blood was shed on the earth, and every imagination and desire of men imagined vanity and evil continually.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord destroyed everything from off the face of the earth; because of the wickedness of their deeds, and because of the blood which they had shed in the midst of the earth He destroyed everything.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: “And we were left, I and you, my sons, and everything that entered with us into the ark, and behold I see your works before me that ye do not walk in righteousness; for in the path of destruction ye have begun to walk, and ye are parting one from another, and are envious one of another, and (so it cometh) that ye are not in harmony, my sons, each with his brother.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: For I see, and behold the demons have begun (their) seductions against you and against your children, and now I fear on your behalf, that after my death ye will shed the blood of men upon the earth, and that ye, too, will be destroyed from the face of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: For whoso sheddeth man’s blood, and whoso eateth the blood of any flesh, will all be destroyed from the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And there will not be left any man that eateth blood. Or that sheddeth the blood of man on the earth, Nor will there be left to him any seed or descendants living under heaven; For into Sheol will they go, And into the place of condemnation will they descend. And into the darkness of the deep will they all be removed by a violent death.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: There shall be no blood seen upon you of all the blood there shall be all the days in which ye have killed any beasts or cattle or whatever flieth upon the earth, and work ye a good work to your souls by covering that which hath been shed on the face of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And ye shall not be like him who eateth with blood, but guard yourselves that none may eat blood before you: cover the blood, for thus have I been commanded to testify to you and your children, together with all flesh.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And suffer not the soul to be eaten with the flesh, that your blood, which is your life, may not be required at the hand of any flesh that sheddeth (it) on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: For the earth will not be clean from the blood which hath been shed upon it; for (only) through the blood of him that shed it will the earth be purified throughout all its generations.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And now, my children, hearken: work judgment and righteousness that ye may be planted in righteousness over the face of the whole earth, and your glory lifted up before my God, who saved me from the waters of the flood.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And behold, ye will go and build for yourselves cities, and plant in them all the plants that are upon the earth, and moreover all fruit-bearing trees.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: For three years the fruit of everything that is eaten will not be gathered: and in the fourth year its fruit will be accounted holy [and they will offer the first-fruits], acceptable before the Most High God, who created heaven and earth and all things. Let them offer in abundance the first of the wine and oil (as) first-fruits on the altar of the Lord, who receiveth it, and what is left let the servants of the house of the Lord eat before the altar which receiveth (it).

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the fifth year . . . . . . .make ye the release so that ye release it in righteousness and uprightness, and ye shall be righteous, and all that you plant will prosper.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: For thus did Enoch, the father of your father command Methuselah, his son, and Methuselah his son Lamech, and Lamech commanded me all the things which his fathers commanded him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah Offers Sacrifice; The Cursing Of Canaan: Noah’s Sons And Grandsons And Their Cities. Noah’s Admonitions
book_of_jubilees.t: And I also will give you commandment, my sons, as Enoch commanded his son in the first jubilees: whilst still living, the seventh in his generation, he commanded and testified to his son and to his sons ’ sons until the day of his death.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: In the twenty-ninth jubilee (1373 A M.), in the first week, in the beginning thereof Arpachshad took to himself a wife and (1375 A.M.) her name was Râsû’ĕjâ, [the daughter of Sûsân,] the daughter of Elam, and she bare him a son in the third year in this week, and he called his name Kâinâm.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: Blessed be the Lord God of Shem, And may the Lord dwell in the dwelling of Shem.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And the son grew, and his father taught him writing, and he went to seek for himself a place where he might seize for himself a city.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And he found a writing which former (generations) had carved on the rock, and he read what was thereon, and he transcribed it and sinned owing to it; for it contained the teaching of the Watchers in accordance with which they used to observe the omens of the sun and moon and stars in all the signs of heaven.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And he wrote it down and said nothing regarding it; for he was afraid to speak to Noah about it lest he should be angry with him on account of it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the thirtieth jubilee, in the second week, in the first year (1429 A.M.) thereof, he took to himself a wife, and her name was Mêlkâ, the daughter of Madai, the son of Japheth, and in the fourth year he begat a son, and called his name Shelah; (1432 A.M.) for he said: “Truly I have been sent.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: [And in the fourth year he was born], and Shelah grew up and took to himself a wife, and her name was Mû’ak, the daughter of Kêsêd, his father’s brother, in the one and thirtieth jubilee, in the fifth week, (1499 A.M.) in the first year thereof.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And she bare him a son in the fifth year thereof, and he called his name Eber: and he took unto himself a wife, and her name was ‘Azûrâd (1503 A.M.) the daughter of Nêbrôd, (1564 A.M.) in the thirty-second jubilee, in the seventh week, in the third year thereof.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth year thereof, (1567 A.M.) she bare him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And they divided (it) secretly amongst themselves, and told it to Noah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass in the beginning of the thirty-third jubilee (1569 A.M.) that they divided the earth into three parts, for Shem and Ham and Japheth, according to the inheritance of each, in the first year in the first week, when one of us, who had been sent, was with them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And he called his sons, and they drew nigh to him, they and their children, and he divided the earth into the lots, which his three sons were to take in possession, and they reached forth their hands, and took the writing out of the bosom of Noah, their father.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And there came forth on the writing as Shem’s lot the middle of the earth which he should take as an inheritance for himself and for his sons for the generations of eternity, from the middle of the mountain range of Râfâ, from the mouth of the water from the river Tînâ. and his portion goeth towards the west through the midst of this river, and it extendeth till it reacheth the water of the abysses, out of which this river goeth forth and poureth its waters into the sea Mê’at, and this river floweth into the great sea. And all that is towards the north is Japheth’s, and all that is towards the south belongeth to Shem.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it extendeth till it reacheth Kârâsô: this is in the bosom of the tongue which looketh towards the south.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And his portion extendeth along the great sea, and it extendeth in a straight line till it reacheth the west of the tongue which looketh towards the south; for this sea is named the tongue of the Egyptian Sea.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it turneth from here towards the south towards the mouth of the great sea on the shore of (its) waters, and it extendeth to the west to ‘Afrâ and it extendeth till it reacheth the waters of the river Gihon, and to the south of the waters of Gihon, to the banks of this river.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it extendeth towards the east, till it reacheth the Garden of Eden, to the south thereof, [to the south] and from the east of the whole land of Eden and of the whole cast, it turneth to the †east,† and proceedeth till it reacheth the east of the mountain named Râfâ, and it descendeth to the bank of the mouth of the river Tînâ.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: This portion came forth by lot for Shem and his sons, that they should possess it for ever unto his generations for evermore.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And Noah rejoiced that this portion came forth for Shem and for his sons, and he remembered all that he had spoken with his mouth in prophecy; for he had said:

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And he knew that the Garden of Eden is the holy of holies, and the dwelling of the Lord, and Mount Sinai the centre of the desert, and Mount Zion--the centre of the navel of the earth: these three were created as holy places facing each other.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And he blessed the God of gods, who had put the word of the Lord into his mouth, and the Lord for evermore.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And he knew that a blessed portion and a blessing had come to Shem and his sons unto the generations for ever--the whole land of Eden and the whole land of the Red Sea, and the whole land of the east, and India, and on the Red Sea and the mountains thereof, and all the land of Bashan, and all the land of Lebanon and the islands of Kaftûr, and all the mountains of Sanîr and ‘Amânâ, and the mountains of Asshur in the north, and all the land of Elam, Asshur, and Bâbêl, and Sûsân and Mâ’ĕdâi and all the mountains of Ararat, and all the region beyond the sea, which is beyond the mountains of Asshur towards the north, a blessed and spacious land, and all that is in it is very good.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Ham came forth the second portion, beyond the Gihon towards the south to the right of the Garden, and it extendeth towards the south and it extendeth to all the mountains of fire, and it extendeth towards the west to the sea of ‘Atêl and it extendeth towards the west till it reacheth the sea of Mâ’ûk --that (sea) into which †everything which is not destroyed descendeth†.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it goeth forth towards the north to the limits of Gâdîr, and it goeth forth to the coast of the waters of the sea to the waters of the great sea till it draweth near to the river Gihon, and goeth along the river Gihon till it reacheth the right of the Garden of Eden.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And this is the land which came forth for Ham as the portion which he was to occupy for ever for himself and his sons unto their generations for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Japheth came forth the third portion beyond the river Tînâ to the north of the outflow of its waters, and it extendeth north-easterly to the whole region of Gog and to all the country east thereof.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it extendeth northerly to the north, and it extendeth to the mountains of Qêlt towards the north, and towards the sea of Mâ’ûk, and it goeth forth to the east of Gâdîr as far as the region of the waters of the sea.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it extendeth until it approacheth the west of Fârâ and it returneth towards ‘Afêrâg, and it extendeth easterly to the waters of the sea of Mê’at.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: And it extendeth to the region of the river Tînâ in a northeasterly direction until it approacheth the boundary of its waters towards the mountain Râfâ, and it turneth round towards the north.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: This is the land which came forth for Japheth and his sons as the portion of his inheritance which he should possess for himself and his sons, for their generations for ever; five great islands, and a great land in the north.

book_of_jubilees.title: Genealogy Of The Descendants Of Shem: Noah And His Sons Divide The Earth
book_of_jubilees.t: But it is cold, and the land of Ham is hot, and the land of Shem is neither hot nor cold, but it is of blended cold and heat.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ham divided amongst his sons, and the first portion came forth for Cush towards the east, and to the west of him for Mizraim, and to the west of him for Put, and to the west of him [and to the west thereof] on the sea for Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: 9 And for Madai came forth as his portion that he should possess from the west of his two brothers to the islands, and to the coasts of the islands.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And Sherri also divided amongst his sons, and the first portion came forth for Elam and his sons, to the east of the river Tigris till it approacheth the east, the whole land of India, and on the Red Sea on its coast, and the waters of Dêdân, and all the mountains of Mebrî and ‘Êlâ, and all the land of Sûsân and all that is on the side of Pharnâk to the Red Sea and the river Tînâ.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Asshur came forth the second portion, all the land of Asshur and Nineveh and Shinar and to the border of India, and it ascendeth and skirteth the river.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Arpachshad came forth the third portion, all the land of the region of the Chaldees to the east of the Euphrates, bordering on the Red Sea, and all the waters of the desert close to the tongue of the sea which looketh towards Egypt, all the land of Lebanon and Sanîr and ‘Amânâ to the border of the Euphrates.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Aram there came forth the fourth portion, all the land of Mesopotamia between the Tigris and the Euphrates to the north of the Chaldees to the border of the mountains of Asshur and the land of ‘Arârâ.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And there came forth for Lud the fifth portion, the mountains of Asshur and all appertaining to them till it reacheth the Great Sea, and till it reacheth the east of Asshur his brother.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And Japheth also divided the land of his inheritance amongst his sons.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And the first portion came forth for Gomer to the east from the north side to the river Tînâ; and in the north there came forth for Magog all the inner portions of the north until it reacheth to the sea of Mê’at.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Javan came forth the fourth portion every island and the islands which are towards the border of Lud.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Tubal there came forth the fifth portion in the midst of the tongue which approacheth towards the border of the portion of Lud to the second tongue, to the region beyond the second tongue unto the third tongue.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Meshech came forth the sixth portion, all the region beyond the third tongue till it approacheth the east of Gâdîr.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And for Tiras there came forth the seventh portion, four great islands in the midst of the sea, which reach to the portion of Ham [and the islands of Kamâtûrî came out by lot for the sons of Arpachshad as his inheritance].

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And thus the sons of Noah divided unto their sons in the presence of Noah their father, and he bound them all by an oath, imprecating a curse on every one that sought to seize the portion which had not fallen (to him) by his lot.

book_of_jubilees.title: Subdivision Of The Three Portions Amongst The Grandchildren: Oath Taken By Noah’s Son
book_of_jubilees.t: And they all said, “So be it; so be it,” for themselves and their sons for ever throughout their generations till the day of judgment, on which the Lord God shall judge them with a sword and with fire, for all the unclean wickedness of their errors, wherewith they have filled the earth with transgression and uncleanness and fornication and sin.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray †the children of† the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: God of the spirits of all flesh, who hast shown mercy unto me, And hast saved me and my sons from the waters of the flood, And hast not caused me to perish as Thou didst the sons of perdition;

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: For Thy grace hath been great towards me, And great hath been Thy mercy to my soul; Let Thy grace be lift up upon my sons, And let not wicked spirits rule over them Lest they should destroy them from the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Noah came to Noah their father, and they told him concerning the demons which were, leading astray and blinding and slaying his sons’ sons.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he prayed before the Lord his God, and said:

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: But do Thou bless me and my sons, that we may increase and multiply and replenish the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Thou knowest how Thy Watchers, the fathers of these spirits, acted in my day: and as for these spirits which are living, imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of thy servant, my God; for these are malignant, and created in order to destroy.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And let them not rule over the spirits of the living; for Thou alone canst exercise dominion over them. And let them not have power over the sons of the righteous from henceforth and for evermore.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord our God bade us to bind all.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Lord, Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say unto them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And He said: “Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And one of us He commanded that we should teach Noah all their medicines; for He knew that they would not walk in uprightness, nor strive in righteousness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And we explained to Noah all the medicines of their diseases, together with their seductions, how he might heal them with herbs of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Noah wrote down all things in a book as we instructed him concerning every kind of medicine. Thus the evil spirits were precluded from (hurting) the sons of Noah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he gave all that he had written to Shem, his eldest son; for he loved him exceedingly above all his sons.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Noah slept with his fathers, and was buried on Mount Lûbâr in the land of Ararat.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: Nine hundred and fifty years he completed in his life, nineteen jubilees (1659 A.M.) and two weeks and five years.

book_of_jubilees.title: Noah’s Sons Led Astray By Evil Spirits; Noah’s Prayer; Mastêmâ; Death Of Noah
book_of_jubilees.t: And in his life on earth he excelled the children of men save Enoch because of the righteousness, wherein he was perfect. For Enoch’s office was ordained for a testimony to the generations of the world, so that he should recount all the deeds of generation unto generation, till the day of judgment.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the three and thirtieth jubilee, in the first year in the second week, Peleg took to himself a wife, whose name was Lômnâ the daughter of Sînâ’ar, and she bare him a son in the fourth year of this week, and he called his name Reu; for he said: “Behold the children of men have become evil through the wicked purpose of building for themselves a city and a tower in the land of Shinar. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: For they departed from the land of Ararat eastward to Shinar; for in his days they built the city and the tower, saying, “Go to, let us ascend thereby into heaven.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: And they began to build, and in the fourth week they made brick with fire, and the bricks served them for stone, and the clay with which they cemented them together was asphalt which cometh out of the sea, and out of the fountains of water in the land of (1645-1688 A.M.) Shinar.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: And they built it: forty and three years were they building it; its breadth was 203 bricks, and the height (of a brick) was the third of one; its height amounted to 5433 cubits and 2 palms, and (the extent of one wall was) thirteen stades (and of the other thirty stades).

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord our God said unto us: “Behold, they are one people, and (this) they begin to do, and now nothing will be withholden from them. Go to, let us go down and confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech, and they may be dispersed into cities and nations, and one purpose will no longer abide with them till the day of judgment. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord descended, and we descended with Him to see the city and the tower which the children of men had built.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another’s speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: For this reason the whole land of Shinar is called Babel, because the Lord did there confound all the language of the children of men, and from thence they were dispersed into their cities, each according to his language and his nation.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord sent a mighty wind against the tower and overthrew it upon the earth, and behold it was between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar, and they called its name ”Overthrow.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Tower Of Babel And The Confusion Of Tongues
book_of_jubilees.t: In the fourth week (1688 A.M.) in the first year in the beginning thereof in the four and thirtieth jubilee, were they dispersed from the land of Shinar.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ham and his sons went into the land which he was to occupy, which he acquired as his portion in the land of the south.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: And Canaan saw the land of Lebanon to the river of Egypt that it was very good, and he went not into the land of his inheritance to the west (that is to) the sea, and he dwelt in the land of Lebanon, eastward and westward from the border of Jordan and from the border of the sea.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ham, his father, and Cush and Mizraim, his brothers, said unto him: “Thou hast settled in a land which. is not thine, and which did not fall to us by lot: do not do so; for if thou dost do so, thou and thy sons will fall in the land and (be) accursed through sedition; for by sedition ye have settled, and by sedition will thy children fall, and thou shalt be rooted out for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: Dwell not in the dwelling of Shem; for to Shem and to his sons did it come by their lot.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: Cursed art thou, and cursed shalt thou be beyond all the sons of Noah, by the curse by which we bound ourselves by an oath in the presence of the holy judge, and in the presence of Noah our father. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: But he did not hearken unto them, and dwelt in the land of Lebanon from Hamath to the entering of Egypt, he and his sons until this day.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: And for this reason that land is named Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: And Japheth and his sons went towards the sea and dwelt in the land of their portion, and Madai saw the land of the sea and it did not please him, and he begged a (portion) from Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad, his wife’s brother, and he dwelt in the land of Media, near to his wife’s brother until this day.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Children Of Noah Enter Their Districts Canaan Seizes Palestine Wrongfully; Madai Receives Media
book_of_jubilees.t: And he called his dwelling-place, and the dwelling-place of his sons, Media, after the name of their father Madai.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the thirty-fifth (1681 A.M.) jubilee, in the third week, in the first year thereof, Reu took to himself a wife, and her name was ‘Ôrâ, the daughter of ‘Ûr, the son of Kêsêd, and (1687 A.M.) she bare him a son, and he called his name Sêrôḫ, in the seventh year of this week in this jubilee.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Noah began to war on each other, to take captive and to slay each other, and to shed the blood of men on the earth, and to eat blood, and to build strong cities, and walls, and towers, and individuals (began) to exalt themselves above the nation, and to found the beginnings of kingdoms, and to go to war people against people, and nation against nation, and city against city, and all (began) to do evil, and to acquire arms, and to teach their sons war, and they began to capture cities, and to sell male and female slaves.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And ‘Ûr, the son of Kêsêd, built the city of ‘Arâ of the Chaldees, and called its name after his own name and the name of his father.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And they made for themselves molten images, and they worshipped each the idol, the molten image which they had made for themselves, and they began to make graven images and unclean simulacra, and malignant spirits assisted and seduced (them) into committing transgression and uncleanness.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And the prince Mastêmâ exerted himself to do all this, and he sent forth other spirits, those which were put under his hand, to do all manner of wrong and sin, and all manner of transgression, to corrupt and destroy, and to shed blood upon the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: For this reason he called the name of Sêrôḫ, Serug, for every one turned to do all manner of sin and transgression.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And he grew up, and dwelt in Ur of the Chaldees, near to the father of his wife’s mother, and he worshipped idols, and he took to himself a wife in the thirty-sixth jubilee (1744 A.M.), in the fifth week, in the first year thereof, and her name was Mêlkâ, the daughter of Kâbêr, the daughter of his father’s brother.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And she bare him Nahor, in the first year of this week, and he grew and dwelt in Ur of the Chaldees, and his father taught him the researches of the Chaldees to divine and augur, according to the signs of heaven.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the thirty-seventh jubilee, in the sixth week (1800 A M.), in the first year thereof, he took to himself a wife, and her name was ‘Îjâskâ, the daughter of Nêstâg of the Chaldees.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And she bare him Terah in the seventh year of this week (1806 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, and rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked (it) from the surface of the ground.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And for this reason he called his name Terah, because the ravens and the birds reduced them to destitution and devoured their seed.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And the years began to be barren, owing to the birds, and they devoured all the fruit of the trees from the trees: it was only with great effort that they could save a little of all the fruit of the earth in their days.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And in this thirty-ninth jubilee (1870 A.M.), in the second week in the first year, Terah took to himself a wife, and her name was ‘Êdnâ, the daughter of ‘Abrâm the daughter of his father ’s sister.

book_of_jubilees.title: The History Of The Patriarchs From Reu To Abraham; The Corruption Of The Human Race
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the seventh year of this week she bare him a son (1876 A.M.), and he called his name Abram, by the name of the father of his mother; for he had died before his daughter had conceived a son.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And the child began to understand the errors of the earth that all went astray after graven images and after uncleanness, and his father taught him writing, and he was two weeks of years old, and he separated (1890 A.M.) himself from his father that he might not worship idols with him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And he began to pray to the Creator of all things that He might save him from the errors of the children of men, and that his portion should not fall into error after uncleanness and vileness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And the seed time came for the sowing of seed upon the land, and they all went forth together to protect their seed against the ravens, and Abram went forth with those that went, and the child was a lad of fourteen years.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And a cloud of ravens came to devour the seed, and Abram ran to meet them before they settled on the ground, and cried to them before they settled on the ground to devour the seed, and said, “Descend not: return to the place whence ye came,” and they proceeded to turn back.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And he caused the clouds of ravens to turn back that day seventy times, and of all the ravens throughout all the land where Abram was there settled there not so much as one.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And all who were with him throughout all the land saw him cry out, and all the ravens turn back, and his name became great in all the land of the Chaldees.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And there came to him this year all those that wished to sow, and he went with them until the time of sowing ceased: and they sowed their land, and that year they brought enough grain home and ate and were satisfied.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the fifth week Abram (1891 A.M.) taught those who made implements for oxen, the artificers in wood, and they made a vessel above the ground, facing the frame of the plough, in order to put the seed thereon, and the seed fell down therefrom upon the share of the plough, and was hidden in the earth, and they no longer feared the ravens.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram’s Knowledge Of God And Wonderful Deeds
book_of_jubilees.t: And after this manner they made (vessels) above the ground on all the frames of the ploughs, and they sowed and tilled all the land, according as Abram commanded them, and they no longer feared the birds.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass (1904 A.M.) in the sixth week, in the seventh year thereof, that Abram said to Terah his father, saying, “Father!” And he said, “Behold, here am I, my son.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: “What help and profit have we from those idols which thou dost worship, And before which thou dost bow thyself?

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And hath created everything by His word, And all life is from before His face.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And on your shoulders do ye bear them, And ye have no help from them,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: But they are a great cause of shame to those who make them, And a misleading of the heart to those who worship them: Worship them not.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou wilt be blessed in the earth, And in thee will all families of the earth be blessed,

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And I shall bless them that bless thee, And curse them that curse thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: May the eternal God make thy path straight, And the Lord [(be) with thee, and] protect thee from all evil, And grant unto thee grace, mercy and favour before those who see thee, And may none of the children of men have power over thee to harm thee; Go in peace.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: For there is no spirit in them, For they are dumb forms, and a misleading of the heart. Worship them not:

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: Worship the God of heaven, Who causeth the rain and the dew to descend on the earth, And doeth everything upon the earth,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: Why do ye worship things that have no spirit in them? For they are the work of (men’s) hands,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And his father said unto him, “I also know it, my son, but what shall I do with a people who have made me to serve before them?

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And if I tell them the truth, they will slay me; for their soul cleaveth to them to worship them and honour them. Keep silent, my son, lest they slay thee. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And these words he spake to his two brothers, and they were angry with him and he kept silent.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: (1925 A.M.) And in the fortieth jubilee, in the second week, in the seventh year thereof, Abram took to himself a wife, and her name was Sarai, the daughter of his father, and she became his wife.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And Haran, his brother, took to himself a wife in the third year of the third week, and she bare him a son in the seventh year of this week and he called his name Lot (1932 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And Nahor, his brother, took to himself a wife.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixtieth year of the life of Abram, that is (1936 A.M.), in the fourth week, in the fourth year thereof, Abram arose by night, and burned the house of the idols, and he burned all that was in the house, and no man knew it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And they arose in the night and sought to save their gods from the midst of the fire.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram Seeks To Convert Terah From Idolatry; The Family Of Terah. Abram Burns The Idols. Death Of Haran
book_of_jubilees.t: And Haran hasted to save them, but the fire flamed over him, and he was burnt in the fire, and he died in Ur of the Chaldees before Terah his father, and they buried him in Ur of the Chaldees.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And Terah went forth from Ur of the Chaldees, he and his sons, to go into the land of Lebanon and into the land of Canaan, and he dwelt in the land of Haran, and Abram, dwelt with Terah his father in Haran two weeks of years.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth week (1951 A.M.), in the fifth year thereof, Abram sat up throughout the night on the new moon of the seventh month to observe the stars from the evening to the morning, in order to see what would be the character of the year with regard to the rains, and he was alone as he sat and observed.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And a word came into his heart and he said: “All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of the Lord. Why do I search (them) out?

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: If He desireth, He causeth it to rain, morning and evening; And if He desireth, He withholdeth it, And all things are in His hand.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And he prayed that night and said “My God, God Most High, Thou alone art my God, And Thee and Thy dominion have I chosen. And Thou hast created all things, And all things that are are the work of Thy hands.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: Deliver me from the hands of evil spirits who have sway over the thoughts of men’s hearts, And let them not lead me astray from Thee, my God. And stablish Thou me and my seed for ever That we go not astray from henceforth and for evermore.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said Shall I return unto Ur of the Chaldees who seek my face that I may return to them, or am I to remain here in this place? The right path before Thee prosper it in the hands of Thy servant that he may fulfil (it) and that I may not walk in the deceitfulness of my heart, O my God.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And he made an end of speaking and praying, and behold the word of the Lord was sent to him through me, saying: “Get thee up from thy country, and from thy kindred and from the house of thy father unto a land which I shall show thee, and I shall make thee a great and numerous nation.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And I shall bless thee And I shall make thy name great,

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And I shall be a God to thee and thy son, and to thy son’s son, and to all thy seed: fear not, from henceforth and unto all generations of the earth I am thy God.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord God said: “Open his mouth and his ears, that he may hear and speak with his mouth, with the language which hath been revealed”; for it had ceased from the mouths of all the children of men from the day of the overthrow (of Babel).

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And I opened his mouth, and his ears and his lips, and I began to speak with him in Hebrew in the tongue of the creation.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And he took the books of his fathers, and these were written in Hebrew and he transcribed them, and he began from henceforth to study them, and I made known to him that which he could not (understand), and he studied them during the six rainy months. (1953 A.M.)

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass in the seventh year of the sixth week that he spoke to his father, and informed him that he would leave Haran to go into the land of Canaan to see it and return to him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And Terah his father said unto him; “Go in peace:

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And if thou seest a land pleasant to thy eyes to dwell in, then arise and take me to thee and take Lot with thee, the son of Haran thy brother, as thine own son: the Lord be with thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Family Of Terah In Haran; Abram’s Experiences There; His Journey To Canaan
book_of_jubilees.t: And Nahor thy brother leave with me till thou returnest in peace, and we go with thee all together.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abram journeyed from Haran, and he took Sarai, his wife, and Lot his brother Haran’s son, to the land of Canaan, and he came into †Asshur†, and proceeded to Shechem, and dwelt near a lofty oak.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: 13 And it came to pass when Pharaoh seized Sarai, the wife of Abram, that the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: 25 . . . . . . . . . . . . . for Abram, and for his seed, a tenth of the first-fruits to the Lord, and the Lord ordained it as an ordinance for ever that they should give it to the priests who served before Him, that they should possess it for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And he saw, and, behold, the land was very pleasant from the entering of Hamath to the lofty oak.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord said to him: “To thee and to thy seed will I give this land.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And he built an altar there, and he offered thereon a burnt sacrifice to the Lord, who had appeared to him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And he removed from thence unto the mountain . . . Bethel on the west and Ai on the east, and pitched his tent there.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And he saw and behold, the land was very wide and good, and everything grew thereon--vines and figs and pomegranates, oaks and ilexes, and terebinths and oil trees, and cedars and cypresses and date trees, and all trees of the field, and there was water on the mountains.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And he blessed the Lord who had led him out of Ur of the Chaldees, and had (1954 A.M.) brought him to this land.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass in the first year, in the seventh week, on the new moon of the first month, that he built an altar on this mountain, and called on the name of the Lord: “Thou, the eternal God, art my God.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And he offered on the altar a burnt sacrifice unto the Lord that He should be with him and not forsake him all the days of his life.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And he removed from thence and went towards the south, and he came to Hebron, and Hebron was built at, that time, and he dwelt there two years, and he went (thence) into the land of the south, to Bealoth and there was a famine in the land.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: (1956 A.M.) And Abram went into Egypt in the third year of the week, and he dwelt in Egypt five years before his wife was torn away from him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: NOW Tanais in Egypt was at that time built--seven years after Hebron.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abram was very glorious by reason of possessions in sheep, and cattle, and asses, and horses, and camels, and menservants, and maidservants, and in silver and gold exceedingly. And Lot also, his brother’s son, was wealthy.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And Pharaoh gave back Sarai, the wife of Abram, and he sent him out of the land of Egypt, and he journeyed to the place where he had pitched his tent at the beginning, to the place of the altar, with Ai on the east, and Bethel on the west, and he blessed the Lord his God who had brought him back in peace.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass in the forty-first jubilee (1963 A.M.), in the third year of the first week, that he returned to this place and offered thereon a burnt sacrifice, and called on the name of the Lord, and said: “Thou, the most high God, art my God for ever and ever.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the fourth year (1964 A.M.) of this week Lot parted from him, and Lot dwelt in Sodom, and the men of Sodom were sinners exceedingly.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: And it grieved him in his heart that his brother’s son had parted from him; for he had no children.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: In that year when Lot was taken captive, the Lord said unto Abram, after that Lot had parted from him, in the fourth year of this week: “Lift up thine eyes from the place where thou art dwelling, northward and southward, and westward and eastward.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: For all the land which thou seest I shall give to thee and to thy seed for ever, and I shall make thy seed as the sand of the sea: though a man may number the dust of the earth, yet thy seed shall not be numbered.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abram With Lot In Canaan And Egypt. Abram Separates From Lot
book_of_jubilees.t: Arise, walk (through the land) in the length of it and the breadth of it, and see it all; for to thy seed shall I give it.” And Abram went to Hebron, and dwelt there.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: And in this year came Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Sêllâsar and Têrgâl, king of nations, and slew the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Sodom fled, and many fell through wounds in the vale of Siddim, by the Salt Sea.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: And they took captive Sodom and Adam and Zeboim, and they took captive Lot also, the son of Abram’s brother, and all his possessions, and they went to Dan.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: And one who had escaped came and told Abram that his brother’s son had been taken captive and (Abram) armed his household servants.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: And to this law there is no limit of days; for He hath ordained it for the generations for ever that they should give to the Lord the tenth of everything, of the seed and of the wine and of the oil and of the cattle and of the sheep.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: And He gave (it) unto His priests to eat and to drink with joy before Him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: And the king of Sodom came to him and bowed himself before him, and said: “Our Lord Abram, give unto us the souls which thou hast rescued, but let the booty be thine.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Campaign Of Chedorlaomer
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abram said unto him: “I lift up my hands to the Most High God, that from a thread to a shoe-latchet I shall not take aught that is thine, lest thou shouldst say I have made Abram rich; save only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me--Aner, Eschol, and Mamre. These will take their portion.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: After these things, in the fourth year of this week, on the new moon of the third month, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a dream, saying: “Fear not, Abram; I am thy defender, and thy reward will be exceeding great.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “Lord, Lord, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go hence childless, and the son of Mâsêq, the son of my handmaid, is the Dammasek Eliezer: he will be my heir, and to me thou hast given no seed.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And He said unto him: “This (man) will not be thy heir, but one that will come out of thine own bowels; he will be thine heir.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And He brought him forth abroad, and said unto him: “Look toward heaven and number the stars, if thou art able to number them.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he looked toward heaven, and beheld the stars. And He said unto him: “So shall thy seed be.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he believed in the Lord, and it was counted to him for righteousness.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And He said unto him: “I am the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee the land of the Canaanites to possess it for ever; and I shall be God unto thee and to thy seed after thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “Lord, Lord, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit (it)?”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said unto him: “Take Me an heifer of three years, and a goat of three years, and a sheep of three years, and a turtle-dove, and a pigeon.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he took all these in the middle of the month; and he dwelt at the oak of Mamre, which is near Hebron.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he built there an altar, and sacrificed all these; and he poured their blood upon the altar, and divided them in the midst, and laid them over against each other; but the birds divided he not.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And birds came down upon the pieces, and Abram drove them away, and did not suffer the birds to touch them.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass, when the sun had set, that an ecstasy fell upon Abram, and lo! an horror of great darkness fell upon him, and it was said unto Abram: “Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land (that is) not theirs, and they will bring them into bondage, and afflict them four hundred years.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And the nation also to whom they will be in bondage shall I judge, and after that they will come forth thence with much substance.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou wilt go to thy fathers in peace, and be buried in a good old age.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: But in the fourth generation they will return hither; for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And he awoke from his sleep, and he arose, and the sun had set; and there was a flame, and behold! a furnace was smoking, and a flame of fire passed between the pieces.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And on that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying: “To thy seed will I give this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates, the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites, the Perizzites, and the Rephaim, the Phakorites, and the Hivites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And the day passed, and Abram offered the pieces, and the birds, and their fruit-offerings, and their drink-offerings, and the fire devoured them.

book_of_jubilees.title: God’s Covenant With Abram
book_of_jubilees.t: And on that day we made a covenant with Abram, according as we had covenanted with Noah in this month; and Abram renewed the festival and ordinance for himself for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Birth Of Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abram rejoiced, and made all these things known to Sarai his wife; and he believed that he would have seed, but she did not bear.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Birth Of Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And Sarai advised her husband Abram, and said unto him: “Go in unto Hagar, my Egyptian maid: it may be that I shall build up seed unto thee by her.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Birth Of Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abram hearkened unto the voice of Sarai his wife, and said unto her, “Do (so).” And Sarai took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to Abram, her husband, to be his wife.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Birth Of Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went in unto her, and she conceived and bare him a son, and he called his name Ishmael, in the fifth year of this week; and this was the eighty-sixth year in the life of Abram.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the fifth year of the †fourth† week of this jubilee, in the third month, in the middle of the month, Abram celebrated the feast of the first-fruits of the grain harvest.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he offered new offerings on the altar, the first-fruits of the produce, unto the Lord, an heifer and a goat and a sheep on the altar as a burnt sacrifice unto the Lord; their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings he offered upon the altar with frankincense.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him: “I am God Almighty; approve thyself before Me and be thou perfect.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And I will make My covenant between Me and thee, and I will multiply thee exceedingly.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, and said:

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: “Behold My ordinance is with thee, And thou wilt be the father of many nations.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: Neither will thy name any more be called Abram, But thy name from henceforth, even for ever, shall be Abraham. For the father of many nations have I made thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And I shall make thee very great, And I shall make thee into nations, And kings will come forth from thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And I shall establish My covenant between Me and thee, and thy seed after thee, throughout their generations, for an eternal covenant, so that I may be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: (And I shall give to thee and to thy seed after thee) the land where thou hast been a sojourner, the land of Canaan, that thou mayst possess it for ever, and I shall be their God.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord said unto Abraham: “And as for thee, do thou keep My Covenant, thou and thy seed after thee, and circumcise ye every male among you, and circumcise your foreskins, and it will be a token of an eternal covenant between Me and you.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And the child on the eighth day ye will circumcise, every male throughout your generations, him that is born in the house, or whom ye have bought with money from any stranger, whom ye have acquired who is not of thy seed.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: He that is born in thy house will surely be circumcised, and those whom thou hast bought with money will be circumcised, and My covenant will be in your flesh for an eternal ordinance.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day, that soul will be cut off from his people, for he hath broken My covenant. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And God said unto Abraham: “As for Sarai thy wife, her name will no more be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And I shall bless her, and give thee a son by her, and I shall bless him, and he will become a nation, and kings of nations will proceed from him. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham fell on his face, and rejoiced, and said in his heart: “Shall a son be born to him that is a hundred years old, and shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bring forth?”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham said unto God: “O that Ishmael might live before thee!”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And God said: “Yea, and Sarah also will bear thee a son, and thou wilt call his name Isaac, and I shall establish My covenant with him, an everlasting covenant, and for his seed after him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And as for Ishmael also have I heard thee, and behold I shall bless him, and make him great, and multiply him exceedingly, and he will beget twelve princes, and I shall make him a great nation.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: But My covenant shall I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to thee, in these days, in the next year.”
