book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And He left off speaking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham did according as God had said unto him, and he took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and whom he had bought with his money, every male in his house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and all the men of his house, (and those born in the house), and all those, whom he had bought with money from the children of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And every one that is born, the flesh of whose foreskin is not circumcised on the eighth day, belongeth not to the children of the covenant which the Lord made with Abraham, but to the children of destruction; nor is there, moreover, any sign on him that he is the Lord’s, but (he is destined) to be destroyed and slain from the earth, and to be rooted out of the earth, for he hath broken the covenant of the Lord our God.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: For all the angels of the presence and all the angels of sanctification have been so created from the day of their creation, and before the angels of the presence and the angels of sanctification He hath sanctified Israel, that they should be with Him and with His holy angels.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou command the children of Israel and let them observe the sign of this covenant for their generations as an eternal ordinance, and they will not be rooted out of the land.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: For the command is ordained for a covenant, that they should observe it for ever among all the children of Israel.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: For Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, the Lord did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Israel to be His people.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all hath He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: But over Israel He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler, and He will preserve them and require them at the hand of His angels and His spirits, and at the hand of all His powers in order that He may preserve them and bless them, and that they may be His and He may be theirs from henceforth for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And now I announce unto thee that the children of Israel will not keep true to this ordinance, and they will not circumcise their sons according to all this law; for in the flesh of their circumcision they will omit this circumcision of their sons, and all of them, sons of Beliar, will leave their sons uncircumcised as they were born.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Feast Of First-Fruits Circumcision Instituted. The Promise Of Isaac’s Birth. Circumcision Ordained For All Israel
book_of_jubilees.t: And there will be great wrath from the Lord against the children of Israel, because they have forsaken His covenant and turned aside from His word, and provoked and blasphemed, inasmuch as they do not observe the ordinance of this law; for they have treated their members like the Gentiles, so that they may be removed and rooted out of the land. And there will no more be pardon or forgiveness unto them [so that there should be forgiveness and pardon] for all the sin of this eternal error.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the new moon of the fourth month we appeared unto Abraham, at the oak of Mamre, and we talked with him, and we announced to him that a son would be given to him by Sarah his wife.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And Sarah laughed, for she heard that we had spoken these words with Abraham, and we admonished her, and she became afraid, and denied that she had laughed on account of the words.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And we told her the name of her son, as his name is ordained and written in the heavenly tables ( i.e. ) Isaac.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And (that) when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And in this month the Lord executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day, even as [lo] I have declared unto thee all their works, that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly, and that they defile themselves and commit fornication in their flesh, and work uncleanness on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And, in like manner, God will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like unto the judgment of Sodom.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: But Lot we saved; for God remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And he and his daughters committed sin upon the earth, such as had not been on the earth since the days of Adam till his time; for the man lay with his daughters.

book_of_jubilees.title: Angelic Visitation Of Abraham In Hebron; Promise Of Isaac’s Birth Repeated. The Destruction Of Sodom And Lot’s Deliverance
book_of_jubilees.t: And, behold, it was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out, and to execute judgment upon them like the judgment of Sodom, and to leave no seed of the man on earth on the day of condemnation.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the middle of the fifth month he moved from thence, and dwelt at the Well of the Oath.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the middle of the sixth month the Lord visited Sarah and did unto her as He had spoken, and she conceived.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And she bare a son in the third month (1980 A.M.), and in the middle of the month, at the time of which the Lord had spoken to Abraham, on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham circumcised his son on the eighth day: he was the first that was circumcised according to the covenant which is ordained for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth year of the †fourth† week we came to Abraham, to the Well of the Oath, and we appeared unto him [as we had told Sarah that we should return to her, and she would have conceived a son.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And we returned in the seventh month, and found Sarah with child before us] and we blessed him, and we announced to him all the things which had been decreed concerning him, that he should not die till he should beget six sons more, and should see (them) before he died; but (that) in Isaac should his name and seed be called:

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And (that) all the seed of his sons should be Gentiles, and be reckoned with the Gentiles; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the Gentiles.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: For he should become the portion of the Most High, and all his seed had fallen into the possession of God, that it should be unto the Lord a people for (His) possession above all nations and that it should become a kingdom and priests and a holy nation.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And we went our way, and we announced to Sarah all that we had told him, and they both rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And he built there an altar to the Lord who had delivered him, and who was making him rejoice in the land of his sojourning, and he celebrated a festival of joy in this month seven days, near the altar which he had built at the Well of the Oath.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And he built booths for himself and for his servants on this festival, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And during these seven days he brought each day to the altar a burnt-offering to the Lord, two oxen, two rams, seven sheep, one he-goat, for a sin-offering, that he might atone thereby for himself and for his seed.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And, as a thank-offering, seven rams, seven kids, seven sheep, and seven he-goats, and their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings; and he burnt all the fat thereof on the altar, a chosen offering unto the Lord for a sweet smelling savour.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And morning and evening he burnt fragrant substances, frankincense and galbanum, and stacte, and nard, and myrrh, and spice, and costum; all these seven he offered, crushed, mixed together in equal parts (and) pure.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And he celebrated this feast during seven days, rejoicing with all his heart and with all his soul, he and all those who were in his house; and there was no stranger with him, nor any that was uncircumcised.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And he blessed his Creator who had created him in his generation, for He had created him according to His good pleasure; for He knew and perceived that from him would arise the plant of righteousness for the eternal generations, and from him a holy seed, so that it should become like Him who had made all things.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And he blessed and rejoiced, and he called the name of this festival the festival of the Lord, a joy acceptable to the Most High God.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And we blessed him for ever, and all his seed after him throughout all the generations of the earth, because he celebrated this festival in its season, according to the testimony of the heavenly tables.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: For this reason it is ordained on the heavenly tables concerning Israel, that they shall celebrate the feast of tabernacles seven days with joy, in the seventh month, acceptable before the Lord--a statute for ever throughout their generations every year.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And to this there is no limit of days; for it is ordained for ever regarding Israel that they should celebrate it and dwell in booths, and set wreaths upon their heads, and take leafy boughs, and willows from the brook.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham At Beersheba. Birth And Circumcision Of Isaac. Institution Of The Feast Of Tabernacles
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham took branches of palm trees, and the fruit of goodly trees, and every day going round the altar with the branches seven times [a day] in the morning, he praised and gave thanks to his God for all things in joy.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the †fifth† week Isaac (1982 A.M.) was weaned in this jubilee, and Abraham made a great banquet in the third month, on the day his son Isaac was weaned.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ishmael, the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, was before the face of Abraham, his father, in his place, and Abraham rejoiced and blessed God because he had seen his sons and had not died childless. .

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And he remembered the words which He had spoken to him on the day on which Lot had parted from him, and he rejoiced because the Lord had given him seed upon the earth to inherit the earth, and he blessed with all his mouth the Creator of all things.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, “Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And the thing was grievous in Abraham’s sight, because of his maidservant and because of his son, that he should drive them from him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And God said to Abraham “Let it not be grievous in thy sight, because of the child and because of the bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken to her words and do (them); for in Isaac shall thy name and seed be called.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: But as for the son of this bondwoman I will make him a great nation, because he is of thy seed. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham rose up early in the morning and took bread and a bottle of water, and placed them on the shoulders of Hagar and the child, and sent her away.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And she departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba, and the water in the bottle was spent, and the child thirsted, and was not able to go on, and fell down.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And his mother took him and cast him under an olive tree, and went and sat her down over against him, at the distance of a bow-shot; for she said, “Let me not see the death of my child,” and as she sat she wept.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And an angel of God, one of the holy ones, said unto her, “Why weepest thou, Hagar? Arise, take the child, and hold him in thine hand; for God hath heard thy voice, and hath seen the child.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And she opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water, and she went and filled her bottle with water, and she gave her child to drink, and she arose and went towards the wilderness of Paran.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And the child grew and became an archer, and God was with him; and his mother took him a wife from among the daughters of Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Expulsion Of Hagar And Ishmael
book_of_jubilees.t: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Nebaioth; for she said, “The Lord was nigh to me when I called upon him.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Mastêmâ Proposes To God That Abraham Shall Be Put To The Proof
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass in the seventh week (2003 A.M.), in the first year thereof, in the first month in this jubilee, on the twelfth of this month, there were voices in heaven regarding Abraham, that he was faithful in all that He told him, and that he loved the Lord, and that in every affliction he was faithful.

book_of_jubilees.title: Mastêmâ Proposes To God That Abraham Shall Be Put To The Proof
book_of_jubilees.t: And the prince Mastêmâ came and said before God, “Behold, Abraham loveth Isaac his son, and he delighteth in him above all things else; bid him offer him as a burnt-offering on the altar, and Thou wilt see if he will do this command, and Thou wilt know if he is faithful in everything wherein Thou dost try him.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Mastêmâ Proposes To God That Abraham Shall Be Put To The Proof
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord knew that Abraham was faithful in all his afflictions; for He had tried him through his country and with famine, and had tried him with the wealth of kings, and had tried him again through his wife, when she was torn (from him), and with circumcision, and had tried him through Ishmael and Hagar, his maid-servant, when he sent them away.

book_of_jubilees.title: Mastêmâ Proposes To God That Abraham Shall Be Put To The Proof
book_of_jubilees.t: And in everything wherein He had tried him, he was found faithful, and his soul was not impatient, and he was not slow to act; for he was faithful and a lover of the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And God said to him, “Abraham, Abraham”; and he said, “Behold, (here) am I.” .

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: That in blessing I shall bless thee And in multiplying I shall multiply thy seed

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And thy seed will inherit the cities of its enemies,

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: Because thou hast obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that thou art faithful unto Me in all that I have said unto thee: Go in peace.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And He said, “Take thy beloved son whom thou lovest, (even) Isaac, and go unto the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out unto thee. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And he rose early in the morning and saddled his ass, and took his two young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood of the burnt-offering, and he went to the place on the third day, and he saw the place afar off.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And he came to a well of water, and he said to his young men, “Abide ye here with the ass, and I and the lad shall go (yonder), and when we have worshipped we shall come again to you.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And he took the wood of the burnt-offering and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took in his hand the fire and the knife, and they went both of them together to that place.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said to his father, “Father”; and he said, “Here am I, my son.” And he said unto him, “Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said, “God will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering, my son.” And he drew near to the place of the mount of God.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And he built an altar, and he placed the wood on the altar, and bound Isaac his son, and placed him on the wood which was upon the altar, and stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay Isaac his son.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And I stood before him, and before the prince of the Mastêmâ, and the Lord said, “Bid him not to lay his hand on the lad, nor to do anything to him, for I have shown that he feareth the Lord.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And I called to him from heaven, and said unto him: “Abraham, Abraham”; and he was terrified and said: “Behold, (here) am I.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And I said unto him: “Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou anything to him; for now I have shown that thou fearest the Lord, and hast not withheld thy son, thy first-born son, from me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught . . . by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham called that place “The Lord hath seen,” so that it is said “(in the mount) the Lord hath seen”: that is Mount Sion.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord called Abraham by his name a second time from heaven, as he caused us to appear to speak to him in the name of the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And He said: “By Myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, Because thou hast done this thing, And hast not withheld thy son, thy beloved son, from Me,

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And in thy seed will all nations of the earth be blessed;

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham went to his young men, and they arose and went together to Beersheba, and Abraham dwelt by the Well of the Oath.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And he celebrated this festival every year, seven days with joy, and he called it the festival of the Lord according to the seven days during which he went and returned in peace.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Sacrifice Of Isaac: Abraham Returns To Beersheba
book_of_jubilees.t: And accordingly hath it been ordained and written on the heavenly tables regarding Israel and its seed that they should observe this festival seven days with the joy of festival.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the first week in the forty-second jubilee (2010 A.M.), Abraham returned and dwelt opposite Hebron, that is Kirjath Arba, two weeks of years.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: For he shall be in my stead on the earth, And for a blessing in the midst of the children of men, And for the glory of the whole seed of Shem.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: To lay the foundations of the heaven, And to strengthen the earth, And to renew all the luminaries which are in the firmament.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the †third† week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him [to see] if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: For in patience of spirit he conversed with the children of Heth, to the intent that they should give him a place in which to bury his dead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: And they besought him, saying, “We shall give it to thee for nothing”; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the days of the life of Sarah were one hundred and twenty-seven years, that is, two jubilees and four weeks and one year: these are the days of the years of the life of Sarah.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: This is the tenth trial wherewith Abraham was tried, and he was found faithful, patient in spirit.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Sarah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that God had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of God.

book_of_jubilees.title: Marriage Of Isaac And Second Marriage Of Abraham; The Birth Of Esau And Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the fourth year (2020 A.M.) thereof he took a wife for his son Isaac and her name was Rebecca [the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, the brother of Abraham] the sister of Laban and daughter of Bethuel; and Bethuel was the son of Mêlcâ, who was the wife of Nahor, the brother of Abraham.

book_of_jubilees.title: Marriage Of Isaac And Second Marriage Of Abraham; The Birth Of Esau And Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham took to himself a third wife, and her name was Keturah, from among the daughters of his household servants, for Hagar had died before Sarah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Marriage Of Isaac And Second Marriage Of Abraham; The Birth Of Esau And Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And she bare him six sons, Zimram, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah, in the two weeks of years.

book_of_jubilees.title: Marriage Of Isaac And Second Marriage Of Abraham; The Birth Of Esau And Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth week (2046 A.M.), in the second year thereof, Rebecca bare to Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau, and Jacob was a smooth and upright man, and Esau was fierce, a man of the field, and hairy, and Jacob dwelt in tents.

book_of_jubilees.title: Marriage Of Isaac And Second Marriage Of Abraham; The Birth Of Esau And Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And the youths grew, and Jacob learned to write; but Esau did not learn, for he was a man of the field and a hunter, and he learnt war, and all his deeds were fierce.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham loved Jacob, but Isaac loved Esau.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abraham saw the deeds of Esau, and he knew that in Jacob should his name and seed be called; and he called Rebecca and gave commandment regarding Jacob, for he knew that she (too) loved Jacob much more than Esau.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said unto her: “My daughter, watch over my son Jacob,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: For I know that the Lord will choose him to be a people for possession unto Himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And behold, Isaac my son loveth Esau more than Jacob, but I see that thou truly lovest Jacob.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: Add still further to thy kindness to him, And let thine eyes be upon him in love; For he will be a blessing unto us on the earth from henceforth unto all generations of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: Let thy hands be strong And let thy heart rejoice in thy son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the blessings wherewith the Lord hath blessed me and my seed shall belong to Jacob and his seed alway.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And in his seed shall my name be blessed, and the name of my fathers, Shem, and Noah, and Enoch, and Mahalalel, and Enos, and Seth, and Adam.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And these shall serve

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And he called Jacob before the eyes of Rebecca his mother, and kissed him, and blessed him, and said:

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: “Jacob, my beloved son, whom my soul loveth, may God bless thee from above the firmament, and may He give thee all the blessings wherewith He blessed Adam, and Enoch, and Noah, and Shem; and all the things of which He told me, and all the things which He promised to give me, may He cause to cleave to thee and to thy seed for ever, according to the days of heaven above the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And the spirits of Mastêmâ shall not rule over thee or over thy seed to turn thee from the Lord, who is thy God from henceforth for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And may the Lord God be a father to thee and thou the first-born son, and to the people alway. Go in peace, my son.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And they both went forth together from Abraham.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham Loves Jacob And Blesses Him
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rebecca loved Jacob, with all her heart and with all her soul, very much more than Esau; but Isaac loved Esau much more than Jacob.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the forty-second jubilee, in the first year of the †seventh† week (2052 (?2045) A.M.), Abraham called Ishmael, and his twelve sons, and Isaac and his two sons, and the six sons of Keturah, and their sons.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: And he commanded them that they should observe the way of the Lord; that they should work righteousness, and love each his neighbour, and act on this manner amongst all men; that they should each so walk with regard to them as to do judgment and righteousness on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: That they should circumcise their sons, according to the covenant which He had made with them, and not deviate to the right hand or the left of all the paths which the Lord had commanded us; and that we should keep ourselves from all fornication and uncleanness, [and renounce from amongst us all fornication and uncleanness].

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: And if any woman or maid commit fornication amongst you, burn her with fire, and let them not commit fornication with her after their eyes and their heart; and let them not take to themselves wives from the daughters of Canaan; for the seed of Canaan will be rooted out of the land.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: And he told them of the judgment of the giants, and the judgment of the Sodomites, how they had been judged on account of their wickedness, and had died on account of their fornication, and uncleanness, and mutual corruption through fornication.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: “And guard yourselves from all fornication and uncleanness, And from all pollution of sin, Lest ye make our name a curse, And your whole life a hissing, And all your sons be destroyed by the sword, And ye become accursed like Sodom, And all your remnant as the sons of Gomorrah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: I implore you, my sons, love the God of heaven, And cleave ye to all His commandments. And walk not after their idols, and after their uncleannesses,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: And make not for yourselves molten or graven gods; For they are vanity, And there is no spirit in them; For they are work of (men’s) hands, And all who trust in them, trust in nothing. Serve them not, nor worship them,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: But serve ye the Most High God, and worship Him continually: And hope for His countenance always, And work uprightness and righteousness before Him, That He may have pleasure in you and grant you His mercy, And send rain upon you morning and evening, And bless all your works which ye have wrought upon the earth, And bless thy bread and thy water, And bless the fruit of thy womb and the fruit of thy land, And the herds of thy cattle, and the flocks of thy sheep.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: And ye will be for a blessing on the earth, And all nations of the earth will desire you, And bless your sons in my name, That they may be blessed as I am.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To His Children And Grandchildren
book_of_jubilees.t: And he gave to Ishmael and to his sons, and to the sons of Keturah, gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, and he gave everything to Isaac his son.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Dwelling-Places Of The Ishmaelites And Of The Sons Of Keturah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ishmael and his sons, and the sons of Keturah and their sons, went together and dwelt from Paran to the entering in of Babylon in all the land which is towards the East facing the desert.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Dwelling-Places Of The Ishmaelites And Of The Sons Of Keturah
book_of_jubilees.t: And these mingled with each other, and their name was called Arabs, and Ishmaelites.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth year (2057 (?2050) A.M.) of the †seventh† week of this jubilee Abraham called Isaac his son, and commanded him, saying: “I am become old, and. know not the day of my death, and am full of my days.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And behold, I am one hundred and seventy-five years old, and throughout all the days of my life I have remembered the Lord, and sought with all my heart to do His will, and to walk uprightly in all His ways.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: My soul hath hated idols, (and I have despised those that served them, and I have given my heart and spirit) that I might observe to do the will of Him who created me.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: For He is the living God, and He is holy and faithful, and He is righteous beyond all, and there is with Him no accepting of (men’s) persons and no accepting of gifts; for God is righteous, and executeth judgment on all those who transgress His commandments and despise His covenant.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou, my son, observe His commandments and His ordinances and His judgments, and walk not after the abominations and after the graven images and after the molten images.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And eat no blood at all of animals or cattle, or of any bird which flieth in the heaven.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And if thou dost slay a victim as an acceptable peace-offering, slay ye it, and pour out its blood upon the altar, and all the fat of the offering offer on the altar with fine flour (and the meat-offering) mingled with oil, with its drink-offering--offer them all together on the altar of burnt-offering; it is a sweet savour before the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou wilt offer the fat of the sacrifice of thank-offerings on the fire which is upon the altar, and the fat which is on the belly, and all the fat on the inwards and the two kidneys, and all the fat that is upon them, and upon the loins and liver thou shalt remove together with the kidneys.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And offer all these for a sweet savour acceptable before the Lord, with its meat-offering and with its drink-offering, for a sweet savour, the bread of the offering unto the Lord,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And eat its meat on that day and on the second day, and let not the sun on the second day go down upon it till it is eaten, and let nothing be left over for the third day; for it is not acceptable [for it is not approved] and let it no longer be eaten, and all who eat thereof will bring sin upon themselves; for thus I have found it written in the books of my forefathers, and in the words of Enoch, and in the words of Noah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And on all thy oblations thou shalt strew salt, and let not the salt of the covenant be lacking in all thy oblations before the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And as regards the wood of the sacrifices, beware lest thou bring (other) wood for the altar in addition to these: cypress, dêfrân, sagâd, pine, fir, cedar, savin, palm, olive, myrrh, laurel, and citron, juniper, and balsam.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And of these kinds of wood lay upon the altar under the sacrifice, such as have been tested as to their appearance, and do not lay (thereon) any split or dark wood, (but) hard and clean, without fault, a sound and new growth; and do not lay (thereon) old wood, [for its fragrance is gone] for there is no longer fragrance in it as before.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: Besides these kinds of wood there is none other that thou shalt place (on the altar), for the fragrance is dispersed, and the smell of its fragrance goeth not up to heaven.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: Observe this commandment and do it, my son, that thou mayst be upright in all thy deeds.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And at all times be clean in thy body, and wash thyself with water before thou approachest to offer on the altar, and wash thy hands and thy feet before thou drawest near to the altar; and when thou art done sacrificing, wash again thy hands and thy feet.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And let no blood appear upon you nor upon your clothes; be on thy guard, my son, against blood, be on thy guard exceedingly; cover it with dust.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And do not eat any blood, for it is the soul; eat no blood whatever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And take no gifts for the blood of man, lest it be shed with impunity, without judgment; for it is the blood that is shed that causeth the earth to sin, and the earth cannot be cleansed from the blood of man save by the blood of him who shed it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And take no present or gift for the blood of man: blood for blood, that thou mayest be accepted before the Lord, the Most High God; for He is the defence of the good: and that thou mayest be preserved from all evil, and that He may save thee from every kind of death..

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: I see, my son, That all the works of the children of men are sin and wickedness, And all their deeds are uncleanness and an abomination and a pollution, And there is no righteousness with them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: Beware, lest thou shouldest walk in their ways And tread in their paths, And sin a sin unto death before the Most High God. Else He will [hide His face from thee, And] give thee back into the hands of thy transgression, And root thee out of the land, and thy seed likewise from under heaven, And thy name and thy seed will perish from the whole earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: Turn away from all their deeds and all their uncleanness, And observe the ordinance of the Most High God, And do His will and be upright in all things.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And He will bless thee in all thy deeds, And will raise up from thee the plant of righteousness through all the earth, throughout all generations of the earth, And my name and thy name will not be forgotten under heaven for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: Go, my son, in peace. May the Most High God, my God and thy God, strengthen thee to do His will, And may He bless all thy seed and the residue of thy seed for the generations for ever, with all righteous blessings, That thou mayest be a blessing on all the earth.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To Isaac
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went out from him rejoicing.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass in the †first† week in the †forty-fourth† jubilee, in the †second† year, that is, the year in which Abraham died, that Isaac and Ishmael came from the Well of the Oath to celebrate the feast of weeks--that is, the feast of the first-fruits of the harvest--to Abraham, their father, and Abraham rejoiced because his two sons had come.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: “Blessed be my son Jacob And all the sons of God Most High, unto all the ages: May God give unto thee a seed of righteousness; And some of thy sons may He sanctify in the midst of the whole earth; May nations serve thee,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the nations bow themselves before thy seed.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And all their ways are a pollution and an abomination and uncleanness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: 21, For, owing to the transgression of Ham, Canaan erred, And all his seed will be destroyed from off the earth and all the residue thereof, And none springing from him will be saved on the day of judgment.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: ( e ) And there will be no remembrance of them on the earth; ( c ) For they will descend into Sheol, ( d ) And into the place of condemnation will they go, As the children of Sodom were taken away from the earth So will all those who worship idols be taken away.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: 26: And the two lay together on one bed, and Jacob slept in the bosom of Abraham, his father’s father and he kissed him seven times, and his affection and his heart rejoiced over him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: For Isaac had many possessions in Beersheba, and Isaac was wont to go and see his possessions and to return to his father.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: And in those days Ishmael came to see his father, and they both came together, and Isaac offered a sacrifice for a burnt-offering, and presented it on the altar of his father which he had made in Hebron.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: And he offered a thank-offering and made a feast of joy before Ishmael, his brother: and Rebecca made new cakes from the new grain, and gave them to Jacob, her son, to take them to Abraham, his father, from the first-fruits of the land, that he might eat and bless the Creator of all things before he died.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac, too, sent by the hand of Jacob to Abraham a best thank-offering, that he might eat and drink.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: And he ate and drank, and blessed the Most High God, Who hath created heaven and earth, Who hath made all the fat things of the earth, And given them to the children of men. That they might eat and drink and bless their Creator.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: “And now I give thanks unto Thee, my God, because Thou hast caused me to see this day: behold, I am one hundred three score and fifteen years, an old man and full of days, and all my days have been unto me peace.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: The sword of the adversary hath not overcome me in all that Thou hast given me and my children all the days of my life until this day.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac, Ishmael And Jacob Join In Festival With Abraham For The Last Time. Abraham’s Prayer
book_of_jubilees.t: My God, may Thy mercy and Thy peace be upon Thy servant, and upon the seed of his sons, that they may be to Thee a chosen nation and an inheritance from amongst all the nations of the earth from henceforth unto all the days of the generations of the earth, unto all the ages. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he called Jacob and said My son Jacob, may the God of all bless thee and strengthen thee to do righteousness, and His will before Him, and may He choose thee and thy seed that ye may become a people for His inheritance according to His will alway. And do thou, my son, Jacob, draw near and kiss me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he drew near and kissed him, and he said:

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: Be strong in the presence of men, And exercise authority over all the seed of Seth. Then thy ways and the ways of thy sons will be justified, So that they shall become a holy nation.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: May the Most High God give thee all the blessings Wherewith he hath blessed me And wherewith He blessed Noah and Adam; May they rest on the sacred head of thy seed from generation to generation for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And may He cleanse thee from all unrighteousness and impurity, That thou mayest be forgiven all (thy) transgressions; (and) thy sins of ignorance. And may He strengthen thee, And bless thee. And mayest thou inherit the whole earth,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And may He renew His covenant with thee, That thou mayest be to Him a nation for His inheritance for all the ages, And that He may be to thee and to thy seed a God in truth and righteousness throughout all the days of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou, my son Jacob, remember my words, And observe the commandments of Abraham, thy father: Separate thyself from the nations, And eat not with them: And do not according to their works, And become not their associate; For their works are unclean,

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: They offer their sacrifices to the dead And they worship evil spirits, And they eat over the graves, And all their works are vanity and nothingness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: They have no heart to understand And their eyes do not see what their works are, And how they err in saying to a piece of wood: ‘Thou art my God,’ And to a stone: ‘Thou art my Lord and thou art my deliverer.’ [And they have no heart.]

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And as for thee, my son Jacob, May the Most High God help thee And the God of heaven bless thee And remove thee from their uncleanness and from all their error.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: Be thou ware, my son Jacob, of taking a wife from any seed of the daughters of Canaan; For all his seed is to be rooted out of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And as for all the worshippers of idols and the profane ( b ) There will be no hope for them in the land of the living;

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: Fear not, my son Jacob, And be not dismayed, O son of Abraham: May the Most High God preserve thee from destruction, And from all the paths of error may He deliver thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: This house have I built for myself that I might put my name upon it in the earth: [it is given to thee and to thy seed for ever], and it will be named the house of Abraham; it is given to thee and to thy seed for ever; for thou wilt build my house and establish my name before God for ever: thy seed and thy name will stand throughout all generations of the earth. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he ceased commanding him and blessing him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he blessed him with all his heart and said: “The Most High God, the God of all, and Creator of all, who brought me forth from Ur of the Chaldees, that He might give me this land to inherit it for ever, and that I might establish a holy seed--blessed be the Most High for ever. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he blessed Jacob and said: “My son, over whom with all my heart and my affection I rejoice, may Thy grace and Thy mercy be lift up upon him and upon his seed alway.

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And do not forsake him, nor set him at nought from henceforth unto the days of eternity, and may Thine eyes be opened upon him and upon his seed, that Thou mayest preserve him, and bless him, and mayest sanctify him as a nation for Thine inheritance;

book_of_jubilees.title: Abraham’s Last Words To And Blessings Of Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And bless him with all Thy blessings from henceforth unto all the days of eternity, and renew Thy covenant and Thy grace with him and with his seed according to all Thy good pleasure unto all the generations of the earth.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And he placed two fingers of Jacob on his eyes, and he blessed the God of gods, and he covered his face and stretched out his feet and slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: And they will use violence against Israel and transgression against Jacob, And much blood will be shed upon the earth, And there will be none to gather and none to bury.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And notwithstanding all this Jacob was lying in his bosom, and knew not that Abraham, his father’s father, was dead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and behold Abraham was cold as ice, and he said: “Father, father!”; but there was none that spake, and he knew that he was dead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And he arose from his bosom and ran and told Rebecca, his mother; and Rebecca went to Isaac in the night and told him; and they went together, and Jacob with them, and a lamp was in his hand, and when they had gone in they found Abraham lying dead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac fell on the face of his father, and wept and kissed him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And the voices were heard in the house of Abraham, and Ishmael his son arose, and went to Abraham his father, and wept over Abraham his father, he and all the house of Abraham, and they wept with a great weeping.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the double cave, near Sarah his wife, and they wept for him forty days, all the men of his house, and Isaac and Ishmael, and all their sons, and all the sons of Keturah in their places, and the days of weeping for Abraham were ended.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Death And Burial Of Abraham
book_of_jubilees.t: And he lived three jubilees and four weeks of years, one hundred and seventy-five years, and completed the days of his life, being old and full of days.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: For the days of the forefathers, of their life, were nineteen jubilees; and after the Flood they began to grow less than nineteen jubilees, and to decrease in jubilees, and to grow old quickly, and to be full of their days by reason of manifold tribulation and the wickedness of their ways, with the exception of Abraham.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: For Abraham was perfect in all his deeds with the Lord, and well-pleasing in righteousness all the days of his life; and behold, he did not complete four jubilees in his life, when he had grown old by reason of the wickedness and was full of his days.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the generations which will arise from this time until the day of the great judgment will grow old quickly, before they complete two jubilees, and their knowledge will forsake them by reason of their old age [and all their knowledge will vanish away].

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: And in those days, if a man live a jubilee and a half of years, they will say regarding him: “He hath lived long, and the greater part of his days are pain and sorrow and tribulation, and there is no peace:

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: For calamity followeth on calamity, and wound on wound, and tribulation on tribulation, and evil tidings on evil tidings, and illness on illness, and all evil judgments such as these, one with another, illness and overthrow, and snow and frost and ice, and fever, and chills, and torpor, and famine, and death, and sword, and captivity, and all kinds of calamities and pains.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: And all these will come on an evil generation, which transgresseth on the earth: their works are uncleanness and fornication, and pollution and abominations.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: Then they will say: “The days of the forefathers were many (even), unto a thousand years, and were good; but, behold, the days of our life, if a man hath lived many, are three score years and ten, and, if he is strong, four score years, and those evil and there is no peace in the days of this evil generation. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: And in that generation the sons will convict their fathers and their elders of sin and unrighteousness, and of the words of their mouth and the great wickednesses which they perpetrate, and concerning their forsaking the covenant which the Lord made between them and Him, that they should observe and do all His commandments and His ordinances and all His laws, without departing either to the right hand or to the left.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Decreasing Years And Increasing Corruption Of Mankind
book_of_jubilees.t: For all have done evil, and every mouth speaketh iniquity and all their works are an uncleanness and an abomination, and all their ways are pollution, uncleanness and destruction.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: Behold the earth will be destroyed on account of all their works, and there will be no seed of the vine, and no oil; for their works are altogether faithless, and they will all perish together, beasts and cattle and birds, and all the fish of the sea, on account of the children of men.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: And they will strive one with another, the young with the old, and the old with the young, the poor with the rich, and the lowly with the great, and the beggar with the prince, on account of the law and the covenant; for they have forgotten commandment, and covenant, and feasts, and months, and Sabbaths, and jubilees, and all judgments.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: And they will stand (with bows and) swords and war to turn them back into the way; but they will not return until much blood hath been shed on the earth, one by another.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: And those who have escaped will not return from their wickedness to the way of righteousness, but they will all exalt themselves to deceit and wealth, that they may each take all that is his neighbour’s, and they will name the great name, but not in truth and not in righteousness, and they will defile the holy of holies with their uncleanness and the corruption of their pollution.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: And a great punishment will befall the deeds of this generation from the Lord, and He will give them over to the sword and to judgment and to captivity, and to be plundered and devoured.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: And He will wake up against them the sinners of the Gentiles, who have neither mercy nor compassion, and who will respect the person of none, neither old nor young, nor any one, for they are more wicked and strong to do evil than all the children of men.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: In those days they will cry aloud, And call and pray that they may be saved from the hand of the sinners, the Gentiles; But none will be saved.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Messianic Woes
book_of_jubilees.t: And the heads of the children will be white with grey hair, And a child of three weeks will appear old like a man of one hundred years, And their stature will be destroyed by tribulation and oppression.

book_of_jubilees.title: Renewed Study Of The Law Followed By A Renewal Of Mankind. The Messianic Kingdom And The Blessedness Of The Righteous
book_of_jubilees.t: And in those days the children will begin to study the laws, And to seek the commandments, And to return to the path of righteousness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Renewed Study Of The Law Followed By A Renewal Of Mankind. The Messianic Kingdom And The Blessedness Of The Righteous
book_of_jubilees.t: And the days will begin to grow many and increase amongst those children of men, Till their days draw nigh to one thousand years, And to a greater number of years than (before) was the number of the days.

book_of_jubilees.title: Renewed Study Of The Law Followed By A Renewal Of Mankind. The Messianic Kingdom And The Blessedness Of The Righteous
book_of_jubilees.t: And there will be no old man Nor one who is not satisfied with his days, For all will be (as) children and youths.

book_of_jubilees.title: Renewed Study Of The Law Followed By A Renewal Of Mankind. The Messianic Kingdom And The Blessedness Of The Righteous
book_of_jubilees.t: And all their days they will complete and live in peace and in joy, And there will be no Satan nor any evil destroyer; For all their days will be days of blessing and healing,

book_of_jubilees.title: Renewed Study Of The Law Followed By A Renewal Of Mankind. The Messianic Kingdom And The Blessedness Of The Righteous
book_of_jubilees.t: And at that time the Lord will heal His servants, And they will rise up and see great peace, And drive out their adversaries. And the righteous will see and be thankful, And rejoice with joy for ever and ever, And will see all their judgments and all their curses on their enemies.

book_of_jubilees.title: Renewed Study Of The Law Followed By A Renewal Of Mankind. The Messianic Kingdom And The Blessedness Of The Righteous
book_of_jubilees.t: And their bones will rest in the earth, And their spirits will have much joy, And they will know that it is the Lord who executeth judgment, And showeth mercy to hundreds and thousands and to all that love Him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Renewed Study Of The Law Followed By A Renewal Of Mankind. The Messianic Kingdom And The Blessedness Of The Righteous
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou, Moses, write down these words; for thus are they written, and they record (them) on the heavenly tables for a testimony for the generations for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac At The Well Of Vision: Esau Sells His Birthright
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that the Lord blessed Isaac his son, and he arose from Hebron and went and dwelt at the Well of the Vision in the first year of the third week of this jubilee, seven years. (2073 A.M.)

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac At The Well Of Vision: Esau Sells His Birthright
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the fourth week a famine began (2080 A.M.) in the land, besides the first famine, which had been in the days of Abraham.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac At The Well Of Vision: Esau Sells His Birthright
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob sod lentil pottage, and Esau came from the field hungry. And he said to Jacob his brother: “Give me of this red pottage.” And Jacob said to him: “Sell to me thy [primogeniture, this] birthright and I will give thee bread, and also some of this lentil pottage.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac At The Well Of Vision: Esau Sells His Birthright
book_of_jubilees.t: And Esau said in his heart: “I shall die; of what profit to me is this birthright?” And he said to Jacob: “I give it to thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac At The Well Of Vision: Esau Sells His Birthright
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob said “Swear to me, this day,” and he sware unto him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac At The Well Of Vision: Esau Sells His Birthright
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob gave his brother Esau bread and pottage, and he ate till he was satisfied, and Esau despised his birthright; for this reason was Esau’s name called Edom, on account of the red pottage which Jacob gave him for his birthright.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac At The Well Of Vision: Esau Sells His Birthright
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob became the elder, and Esau was brought down from his dignity.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And the famine was over the land, and Isaac departed to go down into Egypt in the second year of this week, and went to the king of the Philistines to Gerar, unto Abimelech.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord appeared unto him and said unto him: “Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell thee of, and sojourn in this land, and I shall be with thee and bless thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: For to thee and to thy seed shall I give all this land, and I shall establish My oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father, and I shall multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and shall give unto thy seed all this land.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And in thy seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because thy father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant; and now obey My voice and dwell in this land.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And he dwelt in Gerar three weeks (2080-2101 A.M.) of years.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abimelech charged concerning him, and concerning all that was his, saying: “Any man that shall touch him or aught that is his shall surely die.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac waxed strong among the Philistines, and he got many possessions, oxen and sheep and camels and asses and a great household.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And he sowed in the land of the Philistines and brought in a hundred-fold, and Isaac became exceedingly great, and the Philistines envied him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: Now all the wells which the servants of Abraham had dug during the life of Abraham, the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham, and filled them with earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And Abimelech said unto Isaac: “Go from us, for thou art much mightier than we”; and Isaac departed thence in the first year of the seventh week, and sojourned in the valleys of Gerar (2101 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And they digged again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham, his father, had digged, and which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham his father, and he called their names as Abraham his father had named them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And the servants of Isaac dug a well in the valley, and found living water, and the shepherds of Gerar strove with the shepherds of Isaac, saying: “The water is ours “; and Isaac called the name of the well “Perversity,” because they had been perverse with us.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And they dug a second well, and they strove for that also, and he called its name “Enmity.” And he arose from thence and they digged another well, and for that they strove not, and he called the name of it “Room,” and Isaac said: “Now the Lord hath made room for us, and we have increased in the land.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went up from thence to the Well of the Oath (2108 A.M.) in the first year of the first week in the forty-fourth jubilee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord appeared to him that night, on the new moon of the first month, and said unto him: “I am the God of Abraham thy father; fear not, for I am with thee, and shall bless thee and shall surely multiply thy seed as the sand of the earth, for the sake of Abraham my servant.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And he built an altar there, which Abraham his father had first built, and he called upon the name of the Lord, and he offered sacrifice to the God of Abraham his father.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And they digged a well and they found living water.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And the servants of Isaac digged another well and did not find water, and they went and told Isaac that they had not found water, and Isaac said: “I have sworn this day to the Philistines and this thing hath been announced to us.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And he called the name of that place the “Well of the Oath”; for there he had sworn to Abimelech and Ahuzzath his friend and Phicol the prefect of his host.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Sojourn In Gerar And Dealings With Abimelech
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac knew that day that under constraint he had sworn to them to make peace with them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac Curses The Philistines
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac on that day cursed the Philistines and said: “Cursed be the Philistines unto the day of wrath and indignation from the midst of all nations; may God make them a derision and a curse and an object of wrath and indignation in the hands of the sinners the Gentiles and in the hands of the Kittim.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac Curses The Philistines
book_of_jubilees.t: And whoever escapeth the sword of the enemy and the Kittim, may the righteous nation root out in judgment from under heaven; for they will be the enemies and foes of my children throughout their generations upon the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac Curses The Philistines
book_of_jubilees.t: And no remnant will be left to them, Nor one that will be saved on the day of the wrath of judgment; For for destruction and rooting out and expulsion from the earth is the whole seed of the Philistines (reserved), And there will no longer be left for these Caphtorim a name or a seed on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac Curses The Philistines
book_of_jubilees.t: For though he ascend unto heaven, Thence will he be brought down, And though he make himself strong on earth, Thence will he be dragged forth, And though he hide himself amongst the nations, Even from thence will he be rooted out; And though he descend into Sheol, There also will his condemnation be great, And there also he will have no peace.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac Curses The Philistines
book_of_jubilees.t: And if he go into captivity, By the hands of those that seek his life will they slay him on the way, And neither name nor seed will be left to him on all the earth; For into eternal malediction will he depart.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac Curses The Philistines
book_of_jubilees.t: And thus is it written and engraved concerning him on the heavenly tables, to do unto him on the day of judgment, so that he may be rooted out of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the second year (2109 A.M.) of this week in this jubilee, Rebecca called Jacob her son, and spake unto him, saying: “My son, do not take thee a wife of the daughters of Canaan, as Esau, thy brother, who took him two wives of the daughters of Canaan, and they have embittered my soul with all their unclean deeds: for all their deeds are fornication and lust, and there is no righteousness with them, for (their deeds) are evil.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And I, my son, love thee exceedingly, and my heart and my affection bless thee every hour of the day and watch of the night.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And now, my son, hearken to my voice, and do the will of thy mother, and do not take thee a wife of the daughters of this land, but only of the house of my father, and of my father’s kindred. Thou wilt take thee a wife of the house of my father, and the Most High God will bless thee, and thy children will be a righteous generation and a holy seed.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And then spake Jacob to Rebecca, his mother, and said unto her: “Behold, mother, I am nine weeks of years old, and I neither know nor have I touched any woman, nor have I betrothed myself to any, nor even think of taking me a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: For I remember, mother, the words of Abraham, our father, for he commanded me not to take a wife of the daughters of Canaan, but to take me a wife from the seed of my father’s house and from my kindred.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: I have heard before that daughters have been born to Laban, thy brother, and I have set my heart on them to take a wife from amongst them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And for this reason I have guarded myself in my spirit against sinning or being corrupted in all my ways throughout all the days of my life; for with regard to lust and fornication, Abraham, my father, gave me many commands.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
