book_of_jubilees.t: And, despite all that he hath commanded me, these two and twenty years my brother hath striven with me, and spoken frequently to me and said: ‘My brother, take to wife a sister of my two wives’; but I refuse to do as he hath done.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: I swear before thee, mother, that all the days of my life I will not take me a wife from the daughters of the seed of Canaan, and I will not act wickedly as my brother hath done.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: Fear not, mother; be assured that I shall do thy will and walk in uprightness, and not corrupt my ways for ever.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And thereupon she lifted up her face to heaven and extended the fingers of her hands, and opened her mouth and blessed the Most High God, who had created the heaven and the earth, and she gave Him thanks and praise.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And she said: “Blessed be the Lord God, and may His holy name be blessed for ever and ever, who hath given me Jacob as a pure son and a holy seed; for He is Thine, and Thine shall his seed be continually and throughout all the generations for evermore.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: Bless him, O Lord, and place in my mouth the blessing of righteousness, that I may bless him.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And at that hour, when the spirit of righteousness descended into her mouth, she placed both her hands on the head of Jacob, and said:

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: “Blessed art thou, Lord of righteousness and God of the ages; And may He bless thee beyond all the generations of men. May He give thee, my son, the path of righteousness, And reveal righteousness to thy seed.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And may He make thy sons many during thy life, And may they arise according to the number of the months of the year. And may their sons become many and great beyond the stars of heaven, And their numbers be more than the sand of the sea.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And may He give them this goodly land--as He said He would give it to Abraham and to his seed after him alway -- And may they hold it as a possession for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And may I see (born) unto thee, my son, blessed children during my life, And a blessed and holy seed may all thy seed be.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And as thou hast refreshed thy mother’s spirit during †my† life, The womb of her that bare thee blesseth thee, [My affection] and my breasts bless thee And my mouth and my tongue praise thee greatly.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: Increase and spread over the earth, And may thy seed be perfect in the joy of heaven and earth for ever; And may thy seed rejoice, And on the great day of peace may it have peace.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And may thy name and thy seed endure to all the ages, And may the Most High God be their God, And may the God of righteousness dwell with them, And by them may His sanctuary be built unto all the ages.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: Blessed be he that blesseth thee, And all flesh that curseth thee falsely may it be cursed.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Admonishes Jacob Not To Marry A Canaanitish Woman. Rebecca’s Blessing
book_of_jubilees.t: And she kissed him, and said to him “May the Lord of the world love thee As the heart of thy mother and her affection rejoice in thee and bless thee.” And she ceased from blessing.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the seventh year of this week (2114 A.M.) Isaac called Esau, his elder son, and said unto him: “I am old, my son, and behold my eyes are dim in seeing, and I know not the day of my death.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: “Behold, I have made him thy lord, And all his brethren have I given to him for servants, And with plenty of com and wine and oil have I strengthened him: And what now shall I do for thee, my son?”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: “Hast thou but one blessing, O father? Bless me, (even) me also, father”:

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: “Behold, far from the dew of the earth shall be thy dwelling, And far from the dew of heaven from above.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And now take thy hunting weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and hunt and catch me (venison), my son, and make me savoury meat, such as my soul loveth, and bring it to me that I may eat, and that my soul may bless thee before I die.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: But Rebecca heard Isaac speaking to Esau.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Esau went forth early to the field to hunt and catch and bring home to his father.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rebecca called Jacob, her son, and said unto him: “Behold, I heard Isaac, thy father, speak unto Esau, thy brother, saying: ‘Hunt for me, and make me savoury meat, and bring (it) to me that I may eat and bless thee before the Lord before I die.’

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And now, my son, obey my voice in that which I command thee: Go to thy flock and fetch me two good kids of the goats, and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth, and thou shalt bring (it) to thy father that he may eat and bless thee before the Lord before he die, and that thou mayst be blessed.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob said to Rebecca his mother: “Mother, I shall not withhold anything which my father would eat, and which would please him: only I fear, my mother, that he will recognise my voice and wish to touch me.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou knowest that I am smooth, and Esau, my brother, is hairy, and I shall appear before his eyes as an evildoer, and shall do a deed which he had not commanded me, and he will be wroth with me, and I shall bring upon myself a curse, and not a blessing.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rebecca, his mother, said unto him: “Upon me be thy curse, my son, only obey my voice.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob obeyed the voice of Rebecca, his mother, and went and fetched two good and fat kids of the goats, and brought them to his mother, and his mother made them (savoury meat) such as he loved.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rebecca took the goodly raiment of Esau, her elder son, which was with her in the house, and she clothed Jacob, her younger son, (with them), and she put the skins of the kids upon his hands and on the exposed parts of his neck.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And she gave the meat and the bread which she had prepared into the hand of her son Jacob.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went in to his father and said: “I am thy son: I have done according as thou badest me: arise and sit and eat of that which I have caught, father, that thy soul may bless me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said to his son: “How hast thou found so quickly, my son?”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob said: “Because (the Lord) thy God caused me to find.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said unto him: “Come near, that I may feel thee, my son, if thou art my son Esau or not.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went near to Isaac, his father, and he felt him and said:

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau,” and he discerned him not, because it was a dispensation from heaven to remove his power of perception and Isaac discerned not, for his hands were hairy as (his brother) Esau ’s, so that he blessed him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “Art thou my son Esau?” and he said: “I am thy son and he said, “Bring near to me that I may eat of that which thou hast caught, my son, that my soul may bless thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And he brought near to him, and he did eat, and he brought him wine and he drank.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac, his father, said unto him: “Come near and kiss me, my son.” And he came near and kissed him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And he smelled the smell of his raiment, and he blessed him and said: “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a (full) field which the Lord hath blessed.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And may the Lord give thee of the dew of heaven And of the dew of the earth, and plenty of corn and oil: Let nations serve thee, And peoples bow down to thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee; And may all the blessings wherewith the Lord hath blessed me and blessed Abraham, my father, Be imparted to thee and to thy seed for ever Cursed be he that curseth thee, And blessed be he that blesseth thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing his son Jacob, and Jacob had gone forth from Isaac his father †he hid himself and† Esau, his brother, came in from his hunting.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And he also made savoury meat, and brought (it) to his father, and said unto his father: “Let my father arise, and eat of my venison that thy soul may bless me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac, his father, said unto him: “Who art thou?” And he said unto him: “I am thy first born, thy son Esau: I have done as thou hast commanded me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac was very greatly astonished, and said: “Who is he that hath hunted and caught and brought (it) to me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him: (and) he shall be blessed, and all his seed for ever.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass when Esau heard the words of his father Isaac that he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said unto his father: “Bless me, (even) me also, father.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said unto him: “Thy brother came with guile, and hath taken away thy blessing.” And he said: “Now I know why his name is named Jacob: behold, he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birth-right, and now he hath taken away my blessing.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me, father?” and Isaac answered and said unto Esau:

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Esau said to Isaac, his father:

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac answered and said unto him:

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And by thy sword wilt thou live, And thou wilt serve thy brother. And it shall come to pass when thou becomest great, And dost shake his yoke from off thy neck, Thou wilt sin a complete sin unto death, And thy seed will be rooted out from under heaven.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob Obtains The Blessing Of The Firstborn
book_of_jubilees.t: And Esau kept threatening Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him, and he said in his heart: “May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And the words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebecca in a dream, and Rebecca sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him: 2. “Behold Esau thy brother will take vengeance on thee so as to kill thee. 3. Now, therefore, my son, obey my voice, and arise and flee thou to Laban, my brother, to Haran, and tarry with him a few days until thy brother’s anger turneth away, and he remove his anger from thee, and forget all that thou hast done; then I will send and fetch thee from thence.” 4. And Jacob said: “I am not afraid; if he wisheth to kill me, I will kill him.” 5. But she said unto him: “Let me not be bereft of both my sons on one day.” 6. And Jacob said to Rebecca his mother: “Behold, thou knowest that my father hath become old, and doth not see because his eyes are dull, and if I leave him it will be evil in his eyes, because I leave him and go away from you, and my father will be angry, and will curse me. I will not go; when he sendeth me, then only will I go. ” 7. And Rebecca said to Jacob: “I will go in and speak to him, and he will send thee away.” 8. And Rebecca went in and said to Isaac: “I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau hath taken him as wives; and if Jacob take a wife from among the daughters of the land such as these, for what purpose do I further live; for the daughters of Canaan are evil.” 9. And Isaac called Jacob and blessed him, and admonished him and said unto him: 10. “Do not take thee a wife of any of the daughters of Canaan; arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel, thy mother’s father, and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban, thy mother’s brother. 11. And God Almighty bless thee and increase and multiply thee that thou mayest become a company of nations, and give thee the blessings of my father Abraham, to thee and to thy seed after thee, that thou mayest inherit the land of thy sojournings and all the land which God gave to Abraham: go, my son, in peace.” 12. And Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Mesopotamia, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebecca, Jacob’s mother. 13. And it came to pass after Jacob had arisen to go to Mesopotamia that the spirit of Rebecca was grieved after her son, and she wept.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said to Rebecca: “My sister, weep not on account of Jacob, my son; for he goeth in peace, and in peace will he return.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: The Most High God will preserve him from all evil, and will be with him; for He will not forsake him all his days;

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: For I know that his ways will be prospered in all things wherever he goeth, until he return in peace to us, and we see him in peace.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: Fear not on his account my sister, for he is on the upright path and he is a perfect man: and he is faithful and will not perish. Weep not.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac comforted Rebecca on account of her son Jacob, and blessed him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went from the Well of the Oath to go to Haran on the first year of the second week in the forty-fourth Jubilee, and he came to Luz on the mountains, that is, Bethel, on the new moon of the first month of this week (2115 A.M.), and he came to the place at even and turned from the way to the west of the road that night: and he slept there; for the sun had set.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he took one of the stones of that place and laid it (at his head) under the tree, and he was journeying alone, and he slept.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he dreamt that night, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and behold, the angels of the Lord ascended and descended on it: and behold, the Lord stood upon it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And He spake to Jacob and said: “I am the Lord God of Abraham, thy father, and the God of Isaac; the land whereon thou art sleeping, to thee shall I give it, and to thy-seed after thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And thy seed will be as the dust of the earth, and thou wilt increase to the west and to the east, to the north and the south, and in thee and in thy seed will all the families of the nations be blessed.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And behold, I shall be with thee, and shall keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and I shall bring thee again into this land in peace; for I shall not leave thee until I do everything that I told thee of.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and said, “Truly this place is the house of the Lord, and I knew it not.” And he was afraid and said:” Dreadful is this place which is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob arose early in the morning, and took the stone which he had put under his head and set it up as a pillar for a sign, and he poured oil upon the top of it. And he called the name of that place Bethel; but the name of the place was Luz at the first.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Induces Isaac To Send Jacob To Mesopotamia. Jacob’s Dream And View At Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob vowed a vow unto the Lord, saying: “If the Lord will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and give me bread to eat and raiment to put on, so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, then shall the Lord be my God, and this stone which I have set up as a pillar for a sign in this place, shall be the Lord’s house, and of all that thou givest me, I shall give the tenth to thee, my God.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went on his journey, and came to the land of the east, to Laban, the brother of Rebecca, and he was with him, and served him for Rachel his daughter one week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the third week he said unto him: “Give me my wife, for whom I have served thee seven years;” and Laban said unto Jacob. “I will give thee thy wife.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Laban made a feast, and took Leah his elder daughter, and gave (her) to Jacob as a wife, and gave her Zilpah his handmaid for an handmaid; and Jacob did not know, for he thought that she was Rachel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went in unto her, and behold, she was Leah; and Jacob was angry with Laban, and said unto him: “Why hast thou dealt thus with me? Did not I serve thee for Rachel and not for Leah? Why hast thou wronged me? Take thy daughter, and I will go; for thou hast done evil to me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: For Jacob loved Rachel more than Leah; for Leah’s eyes were weak, but her form was very handsome; but Rachel had beautiful eyes and a beautiful and very handsome form.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Laban said to Jacob: “It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder.” And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder--but the elder one giveth first and after her the younger--and the man who doeth so, they set down guilt against him in heaven, and none is righteous that doeth this thing, for this deed is evil before the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And command thou the children of Israel that they do not this thing; let them neither take nor give the younger before they have given the elder, for it is very wicked.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Laban said to Jacob: “Let the seven days of the feast of this one pass by, and I shall give thee Rachel, that thou mayest serve me another seven years, that thou mayest pasture my sheep as thou didst in the former week. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the day when the seven days of the feast of Leah had passed, Laban gave Rachel to Jacob, that he might serve him another seven years, and he gave to Rachel Bilhah, the sister of Zilpah as a handmaid.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And he served yet other seven years for Rachel, for Leah had been given to him for nothing.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day (2122 A.M.) of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: But the womb of Rachel was closed, for the Lord saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And again Jacob went in unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name (2124 A.M.) Simeon, on the twenty-first of the tenth month, and in the third year of this week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And again Jacob went in unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare him a third son, and he called his name Levi, in the (2127 A.M.) new moon of the first month in the sixth year of this week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And again Jacob went in unto her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Judah, on the fifteenth of the third month (2129 A.M.), in the †first† year of the †fourth† week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And on account of all this Rachel envied Leah, for she did not bear, and she said to Jacob: “Give me children “; and Jacob said: “Have I withheld from thee the fruits of thy womb? Have I forsaken thee?”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And when Rachel saw that Leah had borne four sons to Jacob, Reuben and Simeon and Levi and Judah, she said unto him: “Go in unto Bilhah my handmaid, and she will conceive, and bear a son unto me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: (And she gave (him) Bilhah her handmaid to wife.) And he went in unto her, and she conceived, and bare him a son, and he called his name Dan (2127 A.M.), on the ninth of the sixth month, in the †sixth† year of the †third† week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went in again unto Bilhah a second time, and she conceived, and bare Jacob another son, and Rachel called his name Naphtali, on the fifth of the seventh month, in the second year of the fourth week (2130 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And when Leah saw that she had become sterile and did not bear, she envied (Rachel) and she also gave her handmaid Zilpah to Jacob to wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and Leah called his name Gad, on the twelfth of the eighth month, in the third year of the fourth week (2131 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went in again unto her, and she conceived, and bare him a second son, and Leah called his name Asher, on the second of the eleventh month, in the †fifth† year of the fourth week (2133 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went in unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Issachar, on the fourth of the fifth month, in the †fourth† year of the fourth week (2132 A.M.), and she gave him to a nurse.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went in again unto her, and she conceived, and bare two (children), a son and a daughter, and she called the name of the son Zebulon, and the name of the daughter Dinah, in the seventh of the seventh month, in the sixth year of the fourth week (2134 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the †sixth† year in this fourth week (2134 A.M.).

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the days when Joseph was born, Jacob said to Laban: “Give me my wives and sons, and let me go to my father Isaac, and let me make me an house; for I have completed the years in which I have served thee for thy two daughters, and I will go to the house of my father.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Laban said to Jacob: “†Tarry with me for thy wages† , and pasture my flock for me again, and take thy wages.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And they agreed with one another that he should give him as his wages those of the lambs and kids which were born black and spotted and white, (these) were to be his wages.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the sheep brought forth spotted and speckled and black, variously marked, and they brought forth again lambs like themselves, and all that were spotted were Jacob ’s and those which were not were Laban’s.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob’s possessions multiplied exceedingly, and he possessed oxen and sheep and asses and camels, and menservants and maidservants.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Marriage To Leah And Rachel; His Children And Riches
book_of_jubilees.t: And Laban and his sons envied Jacob, and Laban took back his sheep from him, and he observed him with evil intent.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Laban went to shear his sheep; for they were distant from him a three days’ journey.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob saw that Laban was going to shear his sheep, and Jacob called Leah and Rachel, and spake kindly unto them that they should come with him to the land of Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: For he told them how he had seen everything in a dream, even all that He had spoken unto him that he should return to his father’s house; and they said: “To every place whither thou goest we will go with thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob blessed the God of Isaac his father, and the God of Abraham his father’s father, and he arose and mounted his wives and his children, and took all his possessions and crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead, and Jacob hid (2135 A.M.) his intention from Laban and told him not.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the seventh year of the fourth week Jacob turned (his face) toward Gilead in the first month, on the twenty-first thereof. And Laban pursued after him and overtook Jacob in the mountain of Gilead in the third month, on the thirteenth thereof.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord did not suffer him to injure Jacob; for He appeared to him in a dream by night. And Laban spake to Jacob,

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the fifteenth of those days Jacob made a feast for Laban, and for all who came with him, and Jacob sware to Laban that day, and Laban also to Jacob, that neither should cross the mountain of Gilead to the other with evil purpose.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And he made there a heap for a witness; wherefore the name of that place is called: “The Heap of Witness,” after this heap.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: But before they used to call the land of Gilead the land of the Rephaim; for it was the land of the Rephaim, and the Rephaim were born (there), giants whose height was ten, nine, eight down to seven cubits.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And their habitation was from the land of the children of Ammon to Mount Hermon, and the seats of their kingdom were Karnaim and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, and Mîsûr, and Beon.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord destroyed them because of the evil of their deeds; for they were very malignant, and the Amorites dwelt in their stead, wicked and sinful, and there is no people to-day which hath wrought to the full all their sins, and they have no longer length of life on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Flight With His Family: His Covenant With Laban
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob sent away Laban, and he departed into Mesopotamia, the land of the East, and Jacob returned to the land of Gilead.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: And he passed over the Jabbok in the ninth month, on the eleventh thereof. And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him unto the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the fifth week in this jubilee he crossed the Jordan, and dwelt beyond the Jordan (2136 A.M.), and he pastured his sheep from the sea †of the heap† unto Bethshan, and unto Dothan and unto the †forest† of Akrabbim.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: And he sent to his father Isaac of all his substance, clothing, and food, and meat, and drink, and milk, and butter, and cheese, and some dates of the valley,

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: And to his mother Rebecca also four times a year, between the times of the months, between ploughing and reaping, and between autumn and the rain (season) and between winter and spring, to the tower of Abraham.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: For Isaac had returned from the Well of the Oath and gone up to the tower of his father Abraham, and he dwelt there apart from his son Esau.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: For in the days when Jacob went to Mesopotamia, Esau took to himself a wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, and he gathered together all the flocks of his father and his wives, and went up and dwelt on Mount Seir, and left Isaac his father at the Well of the Oath alone.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac went up from the Well of the Oath and dwelt in the tower of Abraham his father on the mountains of Hebron,

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Reconciled With Esau, Dwells In Canaan And Supports His Parents
book_of_jubilees.t: And thither Jacob sent all that he did send to his father and his mother from time to time, all they needed, and they blessed Jacob with all their heart and with all their soul.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the sixth week (2143 A.M.) he went up to Salem, to the east of Shechem, in peace, in the fourth month.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And he besought his father and her brothers that she might be given to him to wife. And Jacob and his sons were wroth because of the men of Shechem; for they had defiled Dinah, their sister, and they spake to them with evil intent and dealt deceitfully with them and beguiled them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And Simeon and Levi came unexpectedly to Shechem and executed judgment on all the men of Shechem, and slew all the men whom they found in it, and left not a single one remaining in it: they slew all in torments because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Israel be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Israel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord delivered them into the hands of the sons of Jacob that they might exterminate them with the sword and execute judgment upon them, and that it might not thus again be done in Israel that a virgin of Israel should be defiled.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And if there is any man who wisheth in Israel to give his daughter or his sister to any man who is of the seed of the Gentiles he shall surely die, and they shall stone him with stones; for he hath wrought shame in Israel; and they shall burn the woman with fire, because she hath dishonoured the name of the house of her father, and she shall be rooted out of Israel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And let not an adulteress and no uncleanness be found in Israel throughout all the days of the generations of the earth; for Israel is holy unto the Lord, and every man who hath defiled (it) shall surely die: they shall stone him with stones.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: For thus hath it been ordained and written in the heavenly tables regarding all the seed of Israel: he who defileth (it) shall surely die, and he shall be stoned with stones.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And to this law there is no limit of days, and no remission, nor any atonement: but the man who hath defiled his daughter shall be rooted out in the midst of all Israel, because he hath given of his seed to Moloch, and wrought impiously so as to defile it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou, Moses, command the children of Israel and exhort them not to give their daughters to the Gentiles, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the Gentiles, for this is abominable before the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: For this reason I have written for thee in the words of the Law all the deeds of the Shechemites, which they wrought against Dinah, and how the sons of Jacob spake, saying: “We shall not give our daughter to a man who is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And it is a reproach to Israel, to those who give, and to those who take the daughters of the Gentiles; for this is unclean and abominable to Israel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And Israel will not be free from this uncleanness if it hath a wife of the daughters of the Gentiles, or hath given any of its daughters to a man who is of any of the Gentiles.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: For there will be plague upon plague, and curse upon curse, and every judgment and plague and curse will come (upon him): if he do this thing, or hide his eyes from those who commit uncleanness, or those who defile the sanctuary of the Lord, or those who profane His holy name, (then) will the whole nation together be judged for all the uncleanness and profanation of this (man).

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And there will be no respect of persons [and no consideration of persons], and no receiving at his hands of fruits and offerings and burnt-offerings and fat, nor the fragrance of sweet savour, so as to accept it: and so fare every man or woman in Israel who defileth the sanctuary.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: For this reason I have commanded thee, saying: “Testify this testimony to Israel: see how the Shechemites fared and their sons: how they were delivered into the hands of two sons of Jacob, and they slew them under tortures, and it was (reckoned) unto them for righteousness, and it is written down to them for righteousness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before the Lord, as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Israel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And so they inscribe as a testimony in his favour on the heavenly tables blessing and righteousness before the God of all:

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And we remember the righteousness which the man fulfilled during his life, at all periods of the year; until a thousand generations they will record it, and it will come to him and to his descendants after him, and he hath been recorded on the heavenly tables as a friend and a righteous man.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: All this account I have written for thee, and have commanded thee to say to the children of Israel, that they should not commit sin nor transgress the ordinances nor break the covenant which hath been ordained for them, (but) that they should fulfil it and be recorded as friends.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: But if they transgress and work uncleanness in every way, they will be recorded on the heavenly tables as adversaries, and they will be destroyed out of the book of life, and they will be recorded in the book of those who will be destroyed and with those who will be rooted out of the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the day when the sons of Jacob slew Shechem a writing was recorded in their favour in heaven that they had executed righteousness and uprightness and vengeance on the sinners, and it was written for a blessing.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And they brought Dinah, their sister, out of the house of Shechem, and they took captive everything that was in Shechem, their sheep and their oxen and their asses, and all their wealth, and all their flocks, and brought them all to Jacob their father.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And he reproached them because they had put the city to the sword; for he feared those who dwelt in the land, the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

book_of_jubilees.title: Dinah Ravished. Slaughter Of The Shechemites. Laws Against Intermarriage Between Israel And The Heathen. The Choice Of Levi
book_of_jubilees.t: And the dread of the Lord was upon all the cities which are around about Shechem, and they did not rise to pursue after the sons of Jacob; for terror had fallen upon them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the new moon of the month Jacob spake to all the people of his house, saying: “Purify yourselves and change your garments, and let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau my brother, because He hath been with me and brought me into this land in peace, and put ye away the strange gods that are among you.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: They will speak the word of the Lord in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness. And they will declare My ways to Jacob And My paths to Israel. The blessing of the Lord will be given in their mouths To bless all the seed of the beloved.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And they gave up the strange gods and that which was in their ears and which was †on their necks,† and the idols which Rachel stole from Laban her brother she gave wholly to Jacob. And he burnt and brake them to pieces and destroyed them, and hid them under an oak which is in the land of Shechem.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went up on the new moon of the seventh month to Bethel. And he built an altar at the place where he had slept, and he set up a pillar there, and he sent word to his father Isaac to come to him to his sacrifice, and to his mother Rebecca.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said: “Let my son Jacob come, and let me see him before I die.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went to his father Isaac and to his mother Rebecca, to the house of his father Abraham, and he took two of his sons with him, Levi and Judah, and he came to his father Isaac and to his mother Rebecca.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rebecca came forth from the tower to the front of it to kiss Jacob and embrace him; for her spirit had revived when she heard: “Behold Jacob thy son hath come”; and she kissed him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And she saw his two sons, and she recognised them, and said unto him: “Are these thy sons, my son?” and she embraced them and kissed them, and blessed them, saying: “In you shall the seed of Abraham become illustrious, and ye will prove a blessing on the earth.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went in to Isaac his father, to the chamber where he lay, and his two sons were with him, and he took the hand of his father, and stooping down he kissed him, and Isaac clung to the neck of Jacob his son, and wept upon his neck.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the darkness left the eyes of Isaac, and he saw the two sons of Jacob, Levi and Judah, and he said: “Are these thy sons, my son? for they are like thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said unto him that they were truly his sons: “And thou hast truly seen that they are truly my sons.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And they came near to him, and he turned and kissed them and embraced them both together.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the spirit of prophecy came down into his mouth, and he took Levi by his right hand and Judah by his left.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said unto him:, ‘May the God of all, the very Lord of all the ages, bless thee and thy children throughout all the ages.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And may the Lord give to thee and to thy seed †greatness and great glory†, and cause thee and thy seed, from among all flesh, to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones. (Even) as they, will the seed of thy sons be for glory and greatness and holiness, and may He make them great unto all the ages.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob;

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: Thy mother hath called thy name Levi, And justly hath she called thy name; Thou wilt be joined to the Lord And be the companion of all the sons of Jacob; Let His table be thine, And do thou and thy sons eat thereof; And may thy table be full unto all generations, And thy food fail not unto all the ages.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And let all who hate thee fall down before thee, And let all thy adversaries be rooted out and perish; And blessed be he that blesseth thee, And cursed be every nation that curseth thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And to Judah he said: May the Lord give thee strength and power To tread down all that hate thee; A prince shalt thou be, thou and one of thy sons, over the sons of Jacob; May thy name and the name of thy sons go forth and traverse every land and region. Then will the Gentiles fear before thy face, And all the nations will quake [And all the peoples will quake].

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: In thee shall be the help of Jacob, And in thee be found the salvation of Israel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And when thou sittest on the throne of the honour of thy righteousness, There will be great peace for all the seed of the sons of the beloved, And blessed will he be that blesseth thee; And all that hate thee and afflict thee and curse thee Shall be rooted out and destroyed from the earth and accursed.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And turning he kissed him again and embraced him, and rejoiced greatly; for he had seen the sons of Jacob his son in very truth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went forth from between his feet and fell down and worshipped him. And he blessed them. And (Jacob) rested there with Isaac his father that night, and they ate and drank with joy.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he made the two sons of Jacob sleep, the one on his right hand and the other on his left and it was counted to him for righteousness.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob told his father everything during the night, how the Lord had shown him great mercy, and how He had prospered (him in) all his ways, and protected him from all evil.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Journey To Bethel And Hebron. Isaac Blesses Levi And Judah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac blessed the God of his father Abraham, who had not withdrawn His mercy and His righteousness from the sons of His servant Isaac.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Journeys With Jacob To Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the morning Jacob told his father Isaac the vow which he had vowed to the Lord, and the vision which he had seen, and that he had built an altar, and that everything was ready for the sacrifice to be made before the Lord as he had vowed, and that he had come to set him on an ass.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Journeys With Jacob To Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said unto Jacob his son: “I am not able to go with thee; for I am old, and not able to bear the way: go, my son, in peace; for I am one hundred and sixty-five years this day; I am no longer able to journey, set thy mother (on an ass) and let her go with thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Journeys With Jacob To Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And I know, my son, that thou hast come on my account, and may this day be blessed on which thou hast seen me alive, and I also have seen thee, my son.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Journeys With Jacob To Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: Mayest thou prosper and fulfil the vow which thou hast vowed, and put not off thy vow; for thou wilt be called to account as touching the vow; now therefore make haste to perform it, and may He be pleased who hath made all things, to whom thou hast vowed the vow. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Journeys With Jacob To Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said to Rebecca: “Go with Jacob thy son”; and Rebecca went with Jacob her son, and Deborah with her, and they came to Bethel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Journeys With Jacob To Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob remembered the prayer with which his father had blessed him and his two sons, Levi and Judah, and he rejoiced and blessed the God of his fathers, Abraham and Isaac.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca Journeys With Jacob To Bethel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “Now I know that I have an eternal hope, and my sons also, before the God of all;” and thus is it ordained concerning the two; and they record it as an eternal testimony unto them on the heavenly tables how Isaac blessed them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And he abode that night at Bethel, and Levi dreamed that they had ordained and made him the priest of the Most High God, him and his sons for ever; and he awoke from his sleep and blessed the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob rose early in the morning, on the fourteenth of this month, and he gave a tithe of all that came with him, both of men and cattle, both of gold and every vessel and garment, yea, he gave tithes of all.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And in those days Rachel became pregnant with her son Benjamin. And Jacob counted his sons from him upwards and Levi fell to the portion of the Lord, and his father clothed him in the garments of the priesthood and filled his hands.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the fifteenth of this month, he brought to the altar fourteen oxen from amongst the cattle, and twenty-eight rams, and forty-nine sheep, and seven lambs, and twenty-one kids of the goats as a burnt-offering on the altar of sacrifice, well pleasing for a sweet savour before God.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: This was his offering, in consequence of the vow which he had vowed that he would give a tenth, with their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And when the fire had consumed it, he burnt incense on the fire over the fire, and for a thank-offering two oxen and four rams and four sheep, four he-goats, and two sheep of a year old, and two kids of the goats; and thus he did daily for seven days.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And he and all his sons and his men were eating (this) with joy there during seven days and blessing and thanking the Lord, who had delivered him out of all his tribulation and had given him his vow.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And he tithed all the clean animals, and made a burnt sacrifice, but the unclean animals he gave (not) to Levi his son, and he gave him all the souls of the men.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And Levi discharged the priestly office at Bethel before Jacob his father in preference to his ten brothers, and he was a priest there, and Jacob gave his vow: thus he tithed again the tithe to the Lord and sanctified it, and it became holy unto Him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And for this reason it is ordained on the heavenly tables as a law for the tithing again the tithe to eat before the Lord from year to year, in the place where it is chosen that His name should dwell, and to this law there is no limit of days for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: This ordinance is written that it may be fulfilled from year to year in eating the second tithe before the Lord in the place where it hath been chosen, and nothing shall remain over from it from this year to the year following.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: For in its year shall the seed be eaten till the days of the gathering of the seed of the year, and the wine till the days of the wine, and the oil till the days of its season.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And all that is left thereof and becometh old, let it be regarded as polluted: let it be burnt with fire, for it is unclean.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And thus let them eat it together in the sanctuary, and let them not suffer it to become old.

book_of_jubilees.title: Levi’s Dream At Bethel; He Is Appointed To The Priesthood. Jacob Celebrates The Feast Of Tabernacles And Offers Tithes. The Institution Of Tithes
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the tithes of the oxen and sheep shall be holy unto the Lord, and shall belong to His priests, which they will eat before Him from year to year; for thus is it ordained and engraven regarding the tithe on the heavenly tables.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the following night, on the twenty-second day of this month, Jacob resolved to build that place, and to surround the court with a wall, and to sanctify it and make it holy for ever, for himself and his children after him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord appeared to him by night and blessed him and said unto him: “Thy name shall not be called Jacob, but Israel shall they name thy name.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And He said unto him again: “I am the Lord who created the heaven and the earth, and I shall increase thee and multiply thee exceedingly, and kings will come forth from thee, and they will judge everywhere wherever the foot of the sons of men hath trodden.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: Ana I shall give to thy seed all the earth which is under heaven, and they will judge all the nations according to their desires, and after that they will get possession of the whole earth and inherit it for ever. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And He finished speaking with him, and He went up from him, and Jacob looked till He had ascended into heaven.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he saw in a vision of the night, and behold an angel descended from heaven with seven tablets in his hands, and he gave them to Jacob, and he read them and knew all that was written therein which would befall him and his sons through- out all the ages.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he showed him all that was written on the tablets, and said unto him: “Do not build this place, and do not make it an eternal sanctuary, and do not dwell here; for this is not the place. Go to the house of Abraham thy father and dwell with Isaac thy father until the day of the death of thy father.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: For in Egypt thou wilt die in peace, and in this land thou wilt be buried with honour in the sepulchre of thy fathers, with Abraham and Isaac.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: Fear not, for as thou hast seen and read it, thus will. it all be; and do thou write down everything as thou hast seen and read.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob said: “Lord, how can I remember all that I have read and seen?” And he said unto him: “I will bring all things to thy remembrance.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went up from him, and he awoke from his sleep, and he remembered everything which he had read and seen, and he wrote down all the words which he had read and seen.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he celebrated there yet another day, and he sacrificed thereon according to all that he sacrificed on the former days, and called its name † ”Addition,”† for †this day was added,† and the former days he called “The Feast.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And thus it was manifested that it should be, and it is written on the heavenly tables: wherefore it was revealed to him that he should celebrate it, and add it to the seven days of the feast.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And its name was called †”Addition,” † †because that† it was recorded amongst the days of the feast days, †according to† the number of the days of the year.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the night, on the twenty-third of this month, Deborah Rebecca’s nurse died, and they buried her beneath the city under the oak of the river, and he called the name of this place, “The river of Deborah,” and the oak, “The oak of the mourning of Deborah.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rebecca went and returned to her house to his father Isaac, and Jacob sent by her hand rams and sheep and he-goats that she should prepare a meal for his father such as he desired.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And he went after his mother till he came to the land of Kabrâtân, and he dwelt there.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rachel bare a son in the night, and called his name “Son of my sorrow”; for she suffered in giving him birth: but his father called his name Benjamin, on the eleventh of the eighth month in the first of the sixth week (2143 A.M.) of this jubilee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob’s Visions. He Celebrates The Eighth Day Of Tabernacles. The Birth Of Benjamin And Death Of Rachel
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rachel died there and she was buried in the land of Ephrath, the same is Bethlehem, and Jacob built a pillar on the grave of Rachel, on the road above her grave.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob went and dwelt to the south of Magdalâdrâ’êf. And he went to his father Isaac, he and Leah his wife, on the new moon of the tenth month.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And Reuben saw Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, the concubine of his father, bathing in water in a secret place, and he loved her.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And he hid himself at night, and he entered the house of Bilhah [at night], and he found her sleeping alone on a bed in her house.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And he lay with her, and she awoke and saw, and behold Reuben was lying with her in the bed, and she uncovered the border of her covering and seized him, and cried out, and discovered that it was Reuben.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And she was ashamed because of him, and released her hand from him, and he fled.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And she lamented because of this thing exceedingly, and did not tell it to any one.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And when Jacob returned and sought her, she said unto him: “I am not clean for thee, for I have been defiled as regards thee; for Reuben hath defiled me, and hath lain with me in the night, and I was asleep, and did not discover until he uncovered my skirt and slept with me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob was exceedingly wroth with Reuben because he had lain with Bilhah, because he had uncovered his father’s skirt.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob did not approach her again because Reuben had defiled her. And as for any man who uncovereth his father’s skirt his deed is wicked exceedingly, for he is abominable before the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: For this reason it is written and ordained on the heavenly tables that a man should not lie with his father’s wife, and should not uncover his father’s skirt, for this is unclean: they shall surely die together, the man who lieth with his father ’s wife and the woman also, for they have wrought uncleanness on the earth.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And there shall be nothing unclean before our God in the nation which He hath chosen for Himself as a possession.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And again, it is written a second time: “Cursed he be who lieth with the wife of his father, for he hath uncovered his father’s shame”; and all the holy ones of the Lord said “So be it; so be it.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou, Moses, command the children of Israel that they observe this word; for it (entaileth) a punishment of death; and it is unclean, and there is no atonement for ever to atone for the man who hath committed this, but he is to be put to death and slain, and stoned with stones, and rooted out from the midst of the people of our God.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: For to no man who doeth so in Israel is it permitted to remain alive a single day on the earth, for he is abominable and unclean.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And let them not say: to Reuben was granted life and forgiveness after he had lain with his father’s concubine, and to her also though she had a husband, and her husband Jacob, his father, was still alive.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: For until that time there had not been revealed the ordinance and judgment and law in its completeness for all, but in thy days (it hath been revealed) as a law of seasons and of days, and an everlasting law for the everlasting generations.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And for this law there is no consummation of days, and no atonement for it, but they must both be rooted out in the midst of the nation: on the day whereon they committed it they shall slay them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou, Moses, write (it) down for Israel that they may observe it, and do according to these words, and not commit a sin unto death; for the Lord our God is judge, who respecteth not persons and accepteth not gifts.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And tell them these words of the covenant, that they may hear and observe, and be on their guard with respect to them, and not be destroyed and rooted out of the land; for an uncleanness, and an abomination, and a contamination, and a pollution are all they who commit it on the earth before our God.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And there is no greater sin than the fornication which they commit on earth; for Israel is a holy nation unto the Lord its God, and a nation of inheritance, and a priestly and royal nation and for (His own) possession; and there shall no such uncleanness appear in the midst of the holy nation.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the third year of this sixth week (2145 A.M.) Jacob and all his sons went and dwelt in the house of Abraham, near Isaac his father and Rebecca his mother.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And these were the names of the sons of Jacob: the first-born Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulon, the sons of Leah; and the sons of Rachel, Joseph and Benjamin; and the sons of Bilhah, Dan and Naphtali, and the sons of Zilpah, Gad and Asher; and Dinah, the daughter of Leah, the only daughter of Jacob.

book_of_jubilees.title: Reuben’s Sin With Bilhah. Laws Regarding Incest. Jacob’s Children
book_of_jubilees.t: And they came and bowed themselves to Isaac and Rebecca, and when they saw them they blessed Jacob and all his sons, and Isaac rejoiced exceedingly, for he saw the sons of Jacob, his younger son, and he blessed them.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth year of this week (2148 A.M.) of this forty-fourth jubilee Jacob sent his sons to pasture their sheep, and his servants with them, to the pastures of Shechem.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the seven kings of the Amorites assembled themselves together against them, to slay them, hiding themselves under the trees, and to take their cattle as a prey.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob and Levi and Judah and Joseph were in the house with Isaac their father; for his spirit was sorrowful, and they could not leave him: and Benjamin was the youngest, and for this reason remained with his father.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And there came the king[s] of Tâphû, and the king[s] of † ’Arêsa,† and the king[s] of Sêragân, and the king[s] of Sêlô, and the king[s] of Gâ’as, and the king of Bêthôrôn, and the king of † Ma’anîsâkîr,† and all those who dwell in these mountains (and) who dwell in the woods in the land of Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And they announced this to Jacob saying: “Behold, the kings of the Amorites have surrounded thy sons, and plundered their herds.”

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he arose from his housel he and his three sons and all the servants of his father, and his own servants, and he went against them with six thousand men, who carried swords.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he slew them in the pastures of Shechem, and pursued those who fled, and he slew them with the edge of the sword, and he slew † ’Arêsa † and Tâphû and Sarêgân and Sêlô and †’Amânîsakîr† and Gâ[gâ]’as, and he recovered his herds.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he prevailed over them, and imposed tribute on them that they should pay him tribute, five fruit products of their land, and he built Rôbêl and Tamnâtârês
