book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he returned in peace, and made peace with them, and they became his servants, until the day that he and his sons went down into Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the seventh year of this week (2149 A.M.) he sent Joseph to learn about the welfare of his brothers from his house to the land of Shechem, and he found them in the land of Dothan.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And they dealt treacherously with him, and formed a plot against him to slay him, but changing their minds, they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt, and they sold him to Potiphar, the eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the cooks, priest of the city of ‘Êlêw.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Jacob slaughtered a kid, and dipped the coat of Joseph in the blood, and sent (it) to Jacob their father on the tenth of the seventh month.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he mourned all that night, for they had brought it to him in the evening, and he became feverish with mourning for his death, and he said: “An evil beast hath devoured Joseph”; and all the members of his house [mourned with him that day, and they] were grieving and mourning with him all that day.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And his sons and his daughter rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted for his son.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And on that day Bilhah heard that Joseph had perished, and she died mourning him, and she was living in †Qafrâtêf† and Dinah also, his daughter, died after Joseph had perished. And there came these three mournings upon Israel in one month.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And they buried Bilhah over against the tomb of Rachel, and Dinah also, his daughter, they buried there.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he mourned for Joseph one year, and did not cease, for he said “Let me go down to the grave mourning for my son.”

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: For this reason it is ordained for the children of Israel that they should afflict themselves on the tenth of the seventh month--on the day that the news which made him weep for Joseph came to Jacob his father--that they should make atonement for themselves thereon with a young goat on the tenth of the seventh month, once a year, for their sins; for they had grieved the affection of their father regarding Joseph his son.

book_of_jubilees.title: War Of The Amorite Kings Against Jacob And His Sons. Joseph Sold Into Egypt. The Death Of Bilhah And Dinah
book_of_jubilees.t: And this day hath been ordained that they should grieve thereon for their sins, and for all their transgressions and for all their errors, so that they might cleanse themselves on that day once a year.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Wives Of Jacob’s Sons
book_of_jubilees.t: And after Joseph perished, the sons of Jacob took unto themselves wives. The name of Reuben’s wife is ‘Adâ and the name of Simeon ’s wife is ‘Adîbâ’a, a Canaanite; and the name of Levi’s wife is Mêlkâ, of the daughters of Aram, of the seed of the sons of Terah; and the name of Judah ’s wife, Bêtasû’êl, a Canaanite; and the name of Issachar ’s wife, Hêzaqâ; and the name of Zebulon’s wife, †Nî’îmân†; and the name of Dan ’s wife, ‘Êglâ; and the name of Naphtali’s wife, Rasû’û, of Mesopotamia; and the name of Gad’s wife, Mâka; and the name of Asher’s wife, ‘Îjônâ; and the name of Joseph’s wife, Asenath, the Egyptian; and the name of Benjamin ’s wife, ‘Îjasaka.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Wives Of Jacob’s Sons
book_of_jubilees.t: And Simeon repented, and took a second wife from Mesopotamia as his brothers.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the first week (2157 A.M.) of the forty-fifth jubilee Rebecca called Jacob, her son, and commanded him regarding his father and regarding his brother, that he should honour them all the days of his life.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob said: “I will do everything as thou hast commanded me; for this thing will be honour and greatness to me, and righteousness before the Lord, that I should honour them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou too, mother, knowest from the time I was born until this day, all my deeds and all that is in my heart, that I always think good concerning all.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And how should I not do this thing which thou hast commanded me, that I should honour my father and my brother!

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: Tell me, mother, what perversity hast thou seen in me and I shall turn away from it, and mercy will be upon me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And she said unto him: “My son, I have not seen in thee all my days any perverse but (only) upright deeds. And yet I shall tell thee the truth, my son: I shall die this, year, and I shall not survive this year in my life; for I have seen in a dream the day of my death, that I should not live beyond a hundred and fifty-five years: and behold I have completed all the days of my life which I am to live.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob laughed at the words of his mother, because his mother had said unto him that she should die; and she was sitting opposite to him in possession of her strength, and she was not infirm in her strength; for she went in and out and saw, and her teeth were strong, and no ailment had touched her all the days of her life.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob said unto her: “Blessed am I, mother, if my days approach the days of thy life, and my strength remain with me thus as thy strength: and thou wilt not die, for thou art jesting idly with me regarding thy death.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And she went in to Isaac and said unto him: “One petition I make unto thee: make Esau swear that he will not injure Jacob, nor pursue him with enmity; for thou knowest Esau’s thoughts that they are perverse from his youth, and there is no goodness in him; for he desireth after thy death to kill him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou knowest all that he hath done since the day Jacob his brother went to Haran until this day; how he hath forsaken us with his whole heart, and hath done evil to us; thy flocks he hath taken to himself, and carried off all thy possessions from before thy face.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And when we implored and besought him for what was our own, he did as a man who was taking pity on us.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And he is bitter against thee because thou didst bless Jacob thy perfect and upright son; for there is no evil but only goodness in him, and since he came from Haran unto this day he hath not robbed us of aught, for he bringeth us everything in its season always, and rejoiceth with all his heart when we take at his hands, and he blesseth us, and hath not parted from us since he came from Haran until this day, and he remaineth with us continually at home honouring us.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said unto her: “I, too, know and see the deeds of Jacob who is with us, how that with all his heart he honoureth us; but I loved Esau formerly more than Jacob, because he was the first-born; but now I love Jacob more than Esau, for he hath done manifold evil deeds, and there is no righteousness in him, for all his ways are unrighteousness and violence, [and there is no righteousness around him].

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And now my heart is troubled because of all his deeds, and neither he nor his seed is to be saved, for they are those who will be destroyed from the earth, and who will be rooted out from under heaven, for he hath forsaken the God of Abraham and gone after his wives and after their uncleanness and after their error, he and his children.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou dost bid me make him swear that he will not slay Jacob, his brother; even if he swear he will not abide by his oath, and he will not do good but evil only.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: But if he desireth to slay Jacob, his brother, into Jacob’s hands will he be given, and he will not escape from his hands, [for he will descend into his hands.]

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And fear thou not on account of Jacob; for the guardian of Jacob is great and powerful and honoured, and praised more than the guardian of Esau. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And Rebecca sent and called Esau, and he came to her, and she said unto him: “I have a petition, my son, to make unto thee, and do thou promise to do it, my son.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “I will do everything that thou sayest unto me, and I will not refuse thy petition.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And she said unto him: “I ask you that the day I die, thou wilt take me in and bury me near Sarah, thy father’s mother, and that thou and Jacob will love each other, and that neither will desire evil against the other, but mutual love only, and (so) ye will prosper, my sons, and be honoured in the midst of the land, and no enemy will rejoice over you, and ye will be a blessing and a mercy in the eyes of all those that love you.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “I will do all that thou hast told me, and I shall bury thee on the day thou diest near Sarah, my father’s mother, as thou hast desired that her bones may be near thy bones.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob, my brother, also, I shall love above all flesh; for I have not a brother in all the earth but him only: and this is no great merit for me if I love him; for he is my brother, and we were sown together in thy body, and together came we forth from thy womb, and if I do not love my brother, whom shall I love?

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And I, myself, beg thee to exhort Jacob concerning me and concerning my sons, for I know that he will assuredly be king over me and my sons, for on the day my father blessed him he made him the higher and me the lower.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And I swear unto thee that I shall love him, and not desire evil against him all the days of my life but good only.” And he sware unto her regarding all this matter.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And she called Jacob before the eyes of Esau, and gave him commandment according to the words which she had spoken to Esau.

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “I shall do thy pleasure; believe me that no evil will proceed from me or from my sons against Esau, and I shall be first in naught save in love only.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Rebecca’s Last Admonitions And Death
book_of_jubilees.t: And they ate and drank, she and her sons that night, and she died, three jubilees and one week and one year old, on that night, and her two sons, Esau and Jacob, buried her in the double cave near Sarah, their father ’s mother.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth year of this week (2162 A.M.) Isaac called his two sons, Esau and Jacob, and they came to him, and he said unto them: “My sons, I am going the way of my fathers, to the eternal house where my fathers are.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: Wherefore bury me near Abraham my father, in the double cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite, where Abraham purchased a sepulchre to bury in; in the sepulchre which I digged for myself, there bury me.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And this I command you, my sons, that ye practise righteousness and uprightness on the earth, so that the Lord may bring upon you all that the Lord said that he would do to Abraham and to his seed.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And love one another, my sons, your brothers as a man who loveth his own soul, and let each seek in what he may benefit his brother, and act together on the earth; and let them love each other as their own souls.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And concerning the question of idols, I command and admonish you to reject them and hate them, and love them not; for they are full of deception for those that worship them and for those that bow down to them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: Remember ye, my sons, the Lord God of Abraham your father, and how I too worshipped Him and served Him in righteousness and in joy, that He might multiply you and increase your seed as the stars of heaven in multitude, and establish you on the earth as the plant of righteousness which will not be rooted out unto all the generations for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And now I shall make you swear a great oath--for there is no oath which is greater than it by the name glorious and honoured and great and splendid and wonderful and mighty, which created the heavens and the earth and all things together--that ye will fear Him and worship Him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And that each will love his brother with affection and righteousness, and that neither will desire evil against his brother from henceforth for ever all the days of your life, so that ye may prosper in all your deeds and not be destroyed.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And if either of you deviseth evil against his brother, know that from henceforth every one that deviseth evil against his brother will fall into his hand, and will be rooted out of the land of the living, and his seed will be destroyed from under heaven.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: But on the day of turbulence and execration and indignation and anger, with flaming devouring fire as He burnt Sodom, so likewise will He burn his land and his city and all that is his, and he will be blotted out of the book of the discipline of the children of men, and not be recorded in the book of life, but in that which is appointed to destruction, and he will depart into eternal execration; so that their condemnation may be always renewed in hate and in execration and in wrath and in torment and in indignation and in plagues and in disease for ever.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: I say and testify to you, my sons, according to the judgment which will come upon the man who wisheth to injure his brother.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he divided all his possessions between the two on that day, and he gave the larger portion to him that was the first-born, and the tower and all that was about it, and all that Abraham possessed at the Well of the Oath.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said, “This larger portion I shall give to the first-born.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Esau said, “I have sold to Jacob and given my birthright to Jacob; to him let it be given, and I have not a single word to say regarding it, for it is his.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac said, “May a blessing rest upon you, my sons, and upon your seed this day, for ye have given me rest, and my heart is not pained concerning the birthright, lest thou shouldest work wickedness on account of it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: May the Most High God bless the man that worketh righteousness, him and his seed for ever. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he ended commanding them and blessing them, and they ate and drank together before him, and he rejoiced because there was one mind between them, and they went forth from him and rested that day and slept.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Isaac slept on his bed that day rejoicing; and he slept the eternal sleep, and died one hundred and eighty years old. He completed twenty-five weeks and five years; and his two sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Esau went to the land of Edom, to the mountains of Seir, and dwelt there.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob dwelt in the mountains of Hebron, in the tower of the land of the sojournings of his father Abraham, and he worshipped the Lord with all his heart and according to the visible commands according as He had divided the days of his generations.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And Leah his wife (2167 A.M.) died in the fourth year of the second week of the forty-fifth jubilee, and he buried her in the double cave near Rebecca his mother, to the left of the grave of Sarah, his father’s mother.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And all her sons and his sons came to mourn over Leah his wife with him, and to comfort him regarding her, for he was lamenting her.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: For he loved her exceedingly after Rachel her sister died; for she was perfect and upright in all her ways and honoured Jacob, and all the days that she lived with him he did not hear from her mouth a harsh word, for she was gentle and peaceable and upright and honourable.

book_of_jubilees.title: Isaac’s Last Words And Admonitions: His Death. The Death Of Leah
book_of_jubilees.t: And he remembered all her deeds which she had done during her life, and he lamented her exceedingly; for he loved her with all his heart and with all his soul.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the day that Isaac (2162 A.M.) the father of Jacob and Esau died, the sons of Esau heard that Isaac had given the portion of the elder to his younger son Jacob and they were very angry.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: If the boar can change its skin and make its bristles as soft as wool, Or if it can cause horns to sprout forth on its head like the horns of a stag or of a sheep, Then shall I observe the tie of brotherhood with thee. [And if the breasts separated themselves from their mother; for thou hast not been a brother to me.]

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And they strove with their father, saying: “Why hath thy father given Jacob the portion of the elder and passed over thee, although thou art the elder and Jacob the younger?”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said unto them “Because I sold my birthright to Jacob for a small mess of lentils; and on the day my father sent me to hunt and catch and bring him something that he should eat and bless me, he came with guile and brought my father food and drink, and my father blessed him and put me under his hand.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And now our father hath caused us to swear, me and him, that we shall not mutually devise evil, either against his brother, and that we shall continue in love and in peace each with his brother and not make our ways corrupt.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And they said unto him, “We shall not hearken unto thee to make peace with him; for our strength is greater than his strength, and we are more powerful than he; we shall go against him and slay him, and destroy him and his sons. And if thou wilt not go with us, we shall do hurt to thee also.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And now hearken unto us: Let us send to Aram and Philistia and Moab and Ammon, and let us choose for ourselves chosen men who are ardent for battle, and let us go against him and do battle with him, and let us exterminate him from the earth before he groweth strong.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And their father said unto them, “Do not go and do not make war with him lest ye fall before him.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And they said unto him, “This too, is exactly thy mode of action from thy youth until this day, and thou art putting thy neck under his yoke. We shall not hearken to these words.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And they sent to Aram, and to ‘Adurâm to the friend of their father, and they hired along with them one thousand fighting men, chosen men of war.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And there came to them from Moab and from the children of Ammon, those who were hired, one thousand chosen men, and from Philistia, one thousand chosen men of war, and from Edom and from the Horites one thousand chosen fighting men, and from the Kittim mighty men of war.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And they said unto their father: “Go forth with them and lead them, else we shall slay thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he was filled with wrath and indignation on seeing that his sons were forcing him to go before (them) to lead them against Jacob his brother.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: But afterward he remembered all the evil which lay hidden in his heart against Jacob his brother; and he remembered not the oath which he had sworn to his father and to his mother that he would devise no evil all his days against Jacob his brother.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And notwithstanding all this, Jacob knew not that they were coming against him to battle, and he was mourning for Leah, his wife, until they approached very near to the tower with four thousand warriors and chosen men of war.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And the men of Hebron sent to him saying, “Behold thy brother hath come against thee, to fight thee, with four thousand girt with the sword, and they carry shields and weapons”; for they loved Jacob more than Esau. So they told him; for Jacob was a more liberal and merciful man than Esau.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: But Jacob would not believe until they came very near to the tower.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And he closed the gates of the tower; and he stood on the battlements and spake to his brother Esau and said, “Noble is the comfort wherewith thou hast come to comfort me for my wife who hath died. Is this the oath that thou didst swear to thy father and again to thy mother before they died? Thou hast broken the oath, and on the moment that thou didst swear to thy father wast thou condemned.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And then Esau answered and said unto him, “Neither the children of men nor the beasts of the earth have any oath of righteousness which in swearing they have sworn (an oath valid) for ever; but every day they devise evil one against another, and how each may slay his adversary and foe.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And thou dost hate me and my children for ever. And there is no observing the tie of brotherhood with thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: Hear these words which I declare unto thee,

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And if the wolves make peace with the lambs so as not to devour or do them violence, And if their hearts are towards them for good, Then there will be peace in my heart towards thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And if the lion becometh the friend of the ox and maketh peace with him, And if he is bound under one yoke with him and plougheth with him, Then shall I make peace with thee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And when the raven becometh white as the râzâ, Then know that -I have loved thee And shall make peace with thee. Thou shalt be rooted out, And thy sons shall be rooted out, And there shall be no peace for thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: And when Jacob saw that he was (so) evilly disposed towards him with his heart, and with all his soul as to slay him, and that he had come springing like the wild boar which cometh upon the spear that pierceth and killeth it, and recoileth not from it;

book_of_jubilees.title: Esau And His Sons Wage War With Jacob
book_of_jubilees.t: Then he spake to his own and to his servants that they should attack him and all his companions.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And after that Judah spake to Jacob, his father, and said unto him: “Bend thy bow, father, and send forth thy arrows and cast down the adversary and slay the enemy; and mayest thou have the power, for we shall not slay thy brother, for he is such as thou, and he is like thee: let us give him (this) honour.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: Then Jacob bent his bow and sent forth the arrow and struck Esau, his brother, (on his right breast) and slew him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And again he sent forth an arrow and struck ‘Adôrân the Aramaean, on the left breast, and drove him backward and slew him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And then went forth the sons of Jacob, they and their servants, dividing themselves into companies on the four sides of the tower.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah went forth in front, and Naphtali and Gad with him and fifty servants with him on the south side of the tower, and they slew all they found before them, and not one individual of them escaped.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And Levi and Dan and Asher went forth on the east side of the tower, and fifty (men) with them, and they slew the fighting men of Moab and Ammon.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And Reuben and Issachar and Zebulon went forth on the north side of the tower, and fifty men with them, and they slew the fighting men of the Philistines.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And Simeon and Benjamin and Enoch, Reuben’s son, went forth on the west side of the tower, and fifty (men) with them, and they slew of Edom and of the Horites four hundred men, stout warriors; and six hundred fled, and four of the sons of Esau fled with them, and left their father lying slain, as he had fallen on the hill which is in ‘Adûrâm.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Jacob pursued after them to the mountains of Seir. And Jacob buried his brother on the hill which is in ‘Adûrâm, and he returned to his house.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Jacob pressed hard upon the sons of Esau in the mountains of Seir, and bowed their necks so that they became servants of the sons of Jacob.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And they sent to their father (to inquire) whether they should make peace with them or slay them.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob sent word to his sons that they should make peace, and they made peace with them, and placed the yoke of servitude upon them, so that they paid tribute to Jacob and to his sons always.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And they continued to pay tribute to Jacob until the day that he went down into Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: The War Between Jacob And Esau At The Tower Of Hebron. The Death Of Esau And Overthrow Of His Forces
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Edom have not got quit of the yoke of servitude which the twelve sons of Jacob had imposed on them until this day.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And these are the kings that reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Israel [until this day] in the land of Edom.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And Bâlâq, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Danâbâ.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And Bâlâq died, and Jobab, the son of Zârâ of Bôsêr, reigned in his stead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jobab died, and ‘Asâm, of the land of Têmân, reigned in his stead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And ‘Asâm died, and ‘Adâth, the son of Barad, who slew Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead, and the name of his city was Avith.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And ‘Adâth died, and Salman, from ‘Amâsêqâ, reigned in his stead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And Salman died, and Saul of Râ’abôth (by the) river, reigned in his stead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And Saul died, and Ba’êlûnân, the son of Achbor, reigned in his stead.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: And Ba’êlûnân, the son of Achbor, died, and ‘Adâth reigned in his stead, and the name of his wife was Maiṭabîth, the daughter of Mâṭarat, the daughter of Mêtabêdzâ’ab.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Kings Of Edom
book_of_jubilees.t: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings in the land of Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: These are the generations of Jacob. And Joseph was seventeen years old when they took him down into the land of Egypt, and Potiphar, an eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief cook bought him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And he set Joseph over all his house, and the blessing of the Lord came upon the house of the Egyptian on account of Joseph, and the Lord prospered him in all that he did.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Egyptian committed everything into the hands of Joseph; for he saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord prospered him in all that he did.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph’s appearance was comely and very beautiful was his appearance, and his master’s wife lifted up her eyes and saw Joseph, and she loved him, and besought him to lie with her.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: But he did not surrender his soul, and he remembered the Lord and the words which Jacob, his father, used to read from amongst the words of Abraham, that no man should commit fornication with a woman who hath a husband; that for him the punishment of death hath been ordained in the heavens before the Most High God, and the sin will be recorded against him in the eternal books continually before the Lord.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph remembered these words and refused to lie with her.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And she besought him for a year, but he refused and would not listen.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: But she embraced him and held him fast in the house in order to force him to lie with her, and closed the doors of the house and held him fast; but he left his garment in her hands and broke through the door and fled without from her presence.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And the woman saw that he would not lie with her, and she calumniated him in the presence of his lord, saying: “Thy Hebrew servant, whom thou lovest, sought to force me so that he might lie with me; and it came to pass when I lifted up my voice that he fled and left his garment in my hands when I held him, and he brake through the door.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Egyptian saw the garment of Joseph and the broken door, and heard the words of his wife, and cast Joseph into prison into the place where the prisoners were kept whom the king imprisoned.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And he was there in the prison; and the Lord gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph’s Service With Potiphar; His Purity And Imprisonment
book_of_jubilees.t: And he committed all things into his hands, and the chief of -the prison guards knew of nothing that was with him, for Joseph did everything, and the Lord perfected it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Interprets The Dreams Of The Chief Butler And The Chief Baker
book_of_jubilees.t: And he remained there two years. And in those days Pharaoh, king of Egypt, was wroth against his two eunuchs, against the chief butler and against the chief baker, and he put them in ward in the house of the chief cook, in the prison where Joseph was kept.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Interprets The Dreams Of The Chief Butler And The Chief Baker
book_of_jubilees.t: And the chief of the prison guards appointed Joseph to serve them; and he served before them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Interprets The Dreams Of The Chief Butler And The Chief Baker
book_of_jubilees.t: And they both dreamed a dream, the chief butler and the chief baker, and they told it to Joseph.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Interprets The Dreams Of The Chief Butler And The Chief Baker
book_of_jubilees.t: And as he interpreted to them so it befell them, and Pharaoh restored the chief butler to his office, and the (chief) baker he slew, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Interprets The Dreams Of The Chief Butler And The Chief Baker
book_of_jubilees.t: But the chief butler forgot Joseph in the prison, although he had informed him what would befall him, and did not remember to inform Pharaoh how Joseph had told him for he forgot.

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And in those days Pharaoh dreamed two dreams in one night concerning a famine which was to be in all the land, and he awoke from his sleep and called all the interpreters of dreams that were in Egypt, and magicians, and told them his two dreams, and they were not able to declare (them).

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And then the chief butler remembered Joseph and spake of him to the king, and he brought him forth from the prison, and he told his two dreams before him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said before Pharaoh that his two dreams were one, and he said unto him: “Seven years will come (in which there will be) plenty over all the land of Egypt, and after that seven years of famine, such a famine as hath not been in all the land.

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And now let Pharaoh appoint overseers in all the land of Egypt, and let them store up food in every city throughout the days of the years of plenty, and there will be food for the seven years of famine, and the land will not perish through the famine, for it will be very severe. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And the Lord gave Joseph favour and mercy in the eyes of Pharaoh, and Pharaoh said unto his servants: “We shall not find such a wise and discreet man as this man, for the spirit of the Lord is with him.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And he appointed him the second in all his kingdom and gave him authority over all Egypt, and caused him to ride in the second chariot of Pharaoh.

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And he clothed him with byssus garments, and he put a gold chain upon his neck, and (a herald) proclaimed before him “‘Êl ‘Êl wa’ Abîrĕr,” and he placed a ring on his hand and made him ruler over all his house, and magnified him, and said unto him: “Only on the throne shall I be greater than thou.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph ruled over all the land of Egypt, and all the princes of Pharaoh, and all his servants, and all who did the king’s business loved him, for he walked in uprightness, for he was without pride and arrogance, and he had no respect of persons, and did not accept gifts, but he judged in uprightness all the people of the land.

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And the land of Egypt was at peace before Pharaoh because of Joseph, for the Lord was with him, and gave him favour and mercy for all his generations before all those who knew him and those who heard concerning him, and Pharaoh’s kingdom was well ordered, and there was no Satan and no evil person (therein).

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And the king called Joseph’s name Sĕphânṭîphâns, and gave Joseph to wife the daughter of Potiphar, the daughter of the priest of Heliopolis, the chief cook.

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the day that Joseph stood before Pharaoh he was thirty years old [when he stood before Pharaoh].

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And in that year Isaac died. And it came to pass as Joseph had said in the interpretation of his two dreams, according as he had said it, there were seven years of plenty over all the land of Egypt, and the land of Egypt produced abundantly, one measure (producing) eighteen hundred measures.

book_of_jubilees.title: Pharaoh’s Dreams And Their Interpretation. Joseph’s Elevation And Marriage
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph gathered food into every city until they were full of corn until they could no longer count and measure it for its multitude.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the forty-fifth jubilee (2165 A.M.), in the second week, (and) in the second year, Judah took for his first-born Er, a wife from the daughters of Aram, named Tamar.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: But he hated, and did not lie with her, because his mother was of the daughters of Canaan, and he wished to take him a wife of the kinsfolk of his mother, but Judah, his father, would not permit him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And this Er, the first-born of Judah, was wicked, and the Lord slew him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah said unto Onan, his brother: “Go in unto thy brother’s wife and perform the duty of a husband’s brother unto her, and raise up seed unto thy brother. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his, (but) his brother’s only, and he went into the house of his brother’s wife, and spilt the seed on the ground, and he was wicked in the eyes of the Lord, and He slew him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah said unto Tamar, his daughter-in-law: “Remain in thy father’s house as a widow till Shelah my son be grown up, and I shall give thee to him to wife.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And he grew up; but Bêdsû’êl, the wife of Judah, did not permit (2168 A.M.) her son Shelah to marry. And Bêdsû’êl, the wife of Judah, died in the fifth year of this week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the sixth year Judah went up to shear his sheep at Timnah (2169 A.M.). And they told Tamar: “Behold thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And she put off her widow’s clothes, and put on a veil, and adorned herself, and sat in the gate adjoining the way to Timnah.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And as Judah was going along he found her, and thought her to be an harlot, and he said unto her: “Let me come in unto thee”; and she said unto him: “Come in,” and he went in.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And she said unto him: “Give me my hire”; and he said unto her: “I have nothing in my hand save my ring that is on my finger, and my necklace, and my staff which is in my hand.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And she said unto him: “Give them to me until thou dost send me my hire”; and he said unto her: “I will send unto thee a kid of the goats”; and he gave them to her, (and he went in unto her,) and she conceived by him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah went unto his sheep, and she went to her father’s house.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah sent a kid of the goats by the hand of his shepherd, an Adullamite, and he found her not; and he asked the people of the place, saying: “Where is the harlot who was here?” And they said unto him: “There is no harlot here with us.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And he returned and informed him, and said unto him that he had not found her; “I asked the people of the place, and they said unto me: ‘There is no harlot here.’” And he said: “Let her keep (them) lest we become a cause of derision.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And when she had completed three months, it was manifest that she was with child, and they told Judah, saying: “Behold Tamar, thy daughter-in-law, is with child by whoredom.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah went to the house of her father, and said unto her father and her brothers: “Bring her forth, and let them burn her, for she hath wrought uncleanness in Israel. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And it came to pass when they brought her forth to bum her that she sent to her father-in-law the ring and the necklace, and the staff, saying: “Discern whose are these, for by him am I with child.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah acknowledged, and said: “Tamar is more righteous than I am. And therefore let them burn her not.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And for that reason she was not given to Shelah, and he did not again approach her.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And after that she bare two sons, (2170 A.M.) Perez and Zerah, in the seventh year of this second week.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And thereupon the seven years of fruitfulness were accomplished, of which Joseph spake to Pharaoh.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah acknowledged that the deed which he had done was evil, for he had lain with his daughter-in-law, and he esteemed it hateful in his eyes, and he acknowledged that he had transgressed and gone astray; for he had uncovered the skirt of his son, and he began to lament and to supplicate before the Lord because of his transgression.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And we told him in a dream that it was forgiven him because he supplicated earnestly, and lamented, and did not again commit it.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And he received forgiveness because he turned from his sin and from his ignorance, for he transgressed greatly before our God; and every one that acteth thus, every one who lieth with his mother-in-law, let them burn him with fire that he may bum therein, for there is uncleanness and pollution upon them; with fire let them bum them.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And do thou command the children of Israel that there be no uncleanness amongst them, for every one who lieth with his daughter-in-law or with his mother-in-law hath wrought uncleanness; with fire let them bum the man who hath lain with her, and likewise the woman, and He will turn away wrath and punishment from Israel.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: And unto Judah we said that his two sons had not lain with her, and for this reason his seed was established for a second generation, and would not be rooted out.

book_of_jubilees.title: Judah’s Incest With Tamar; His Repentance And Forgiveness
book_of_jubilees.t: For in singleness of eye he had gone and sought for punishment, namely, according to the judgment of Abraham, which he had commanded his sons, Judah had sought to burn her with fire.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the first year of the third week (2171 A.M.) of the forty-fifth jubilee the famine began to come into the land, and the rain refused to be given to the earth, for none whatever fell.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: 3 . And the Egyptians came to Joseph that he might give them food, and he opened the storehouses where was the grain of the first year, and he sold it to the people of the land for gold.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: “Fill all their sacks with food, and return their money unto them into their vessels, and my cup, the silver cup out of which I drink, put it in the sack of the youngest, and send them away.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And the earth grew barren, but in the land of Egypt there was food, for Joseph had gathered the seed of the land in the seven years of plenty and had preserved it.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: (Now the famine was very sore in the land of Canaan), and Jacob heard that there was food in Egypt, and he sent his ten sons that they should procure food for him in Egypt; but Benjamin he did not send, and (the ten sons of Jacob) arrived (in Egypt) among those that went (there.)

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph recognized them, but they did not recognize him, and he spake unto them and questioned them, and he said unto them: “Are ye not spies, and have ye not come to explore the approaches of the land?” And he put them in ward.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And after that he set them free again, and detained Simeon alone and sent off his nine brothers.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And he filled their sacks with corn, and he put their gold in their sacks, and they did not know.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And he commanded them to bring their younger brother, for they had told him their father was living and their younger brother.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And they went up from the land of Egypt and they came to the land of Canaan; and they told their father all that had befallen them, and how the lord of the country had spoken roughly to them, and had seized Simeon till they should bring Benjamin.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob said: “Me have ye bereaved of my children! Joseph is not and Simeon also is not, and ye will take Benjamin away. On me hath your wickedness come.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said: “My son will not go down with you lest perchance he fall sick; for their mother gave birth to two sons, and one hath perished, and this one also ye will take from me. If perchance he took a fever on the road, ye would bring down my old age with sorrow unto death. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: For he saw that their money had been returned to every man in his sack, and for this reason he feared to send him.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And the famine increased and became sore in the land of Canaan, and in all lands save in the land of Egypt, for many of the children of the Egyptians had stored up their seed for food from the time when they saw Joseph gathering seed together and putting it in storehouses and preserving it for the years of famine.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And the people of Egypt fed themselves thereon during the first year of their famine.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: But when Israel saw that the famine was very sore in the land, and there was no deliverance, he said unto his sons: “Go again, and procure food for us that we die not.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And they said: “We shall not go; unless our youngest brother go with us, we shall not go.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And Israel saw that if he did not send him with them, they should all perish by reason of the famine.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And Reuben said: “Give him into my hand, and if I do not bring him back to thee, slay my two sons instead of his soul.” And he said unto him He will not go with thee.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah came near and said: “Send him with me, and if I do not bring him back to thee, let me bear the blame before thee all the days of my life.”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: (2172 A.M.) And he sent him with them in the second year of this week on the first day of the month, and they came to the land of Egypt with all those who went, and (they had) presents in their hands, stacte and almonds and terebinth nuts and pure honey.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And they went and stood before Joseph, and he saw Benjamin his brother, and he knew him, and said unto them: “Is this your youngest brother?” And they said unto him: “It is he.” And he said: “The Lord be gracious to thee, my son!”

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And he sent him into his house and he brought forth Simeon unto them and he made a feast for them, and they presented to him the gift which they had brought in their hands.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And they ate before him and he gave them all a portion, but the portion of Benjamin was seven times larger than that of any of theirs.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And they ate and drank and arose and remained with their asses.

book_of_jubilees.title: The Two Journeys Of The Sons Of Jacob To Egypt
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph devised a plan whereby he might learn their thoughts as to whether thoughts of peace prevailed amongst them, and he said to the steward who was over his house:

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And he did as Joseph had told him, and filled all their sacks for them with food and put their money in their sacks, and put the cup in Benjamin’s sack.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And early in the morning they departed, and it came to pass that, when they had gone from thence, Joseph said unto the steward of his house: “Pursue them, run and seize them, saying, ‘For good ye have requited me with evil; you have stolen from me the silver cup out of which my lord drinks.’ And bring back to me their youngest brother, and fetch (him) quickly before I go forth to my seat of judgment.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And he ran after them and said unto them according to these words.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And they said unto him: “God forbid that thy servants should do this thing, and steal from the house of thy lord any utensil, and the money also which we found in our sacks the first time, we thy servants brought back from the land of Canaan.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: How then should we steal any utensil? Behold here are we and our sacks; search, and wherever thou findest the cup in the sack of any man amongst us, let him be slain, and we and our asses will serve thy lord.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said unto them: “Not so, the man with whom I find, him only shall I take as a servant, and ye will return in peace unto your house.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And as he was searching in their vessels, beginning with the eldest and ending with the youngest, it was found in Benjamin’s sack.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And they rent their garments, and laded their asses, and returned to the city and came to the house of Joseph, and they all bowed themselves on their faces to the ground before him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph said unto them: “Ye have done evil.” And they said: “What shall we say and how shall we defend ourselves? Our lord hath discovered the transgression of his servants; behold we are the servants of our lord, and our asses also.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph said unto them: “I too fear the Lord; as for you, go ye to your homes and let your brother be my servant, for ye have done evil.. Know ye not that a man delighteth in his cup as I with this cup? And yet ye have stolen it from me. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And Judah said: “O my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ear; two brothers did thy servant’s mother bear to our father; one went away and was lost, and hath not been found, and he alone is left of his mother, and thy servant our father loveth him, and his life also is bound up with the life of this (lad).

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And it will come to pass, when we go to thy servant our father, and the lad is not with us, that he will die, and we shall bring down our father with sorrow unto death.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: Now rather let me, thy servant, abide instead of the boy as a bondsman unto my lord, and let the lad go with his brethren, for I became surety for him at the hand of thy servant our father, and if I do not bring him back, thy servant will bear the blame to our father for ever.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph saw that they were all accordant in goodness one with another, and he could not refrain himself, and he told them that he was Joseph.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And he conversed with them in the Hebrew tongue and fell on their neck and wept. But they knew him not and they began to weep.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And he said unto them: “Weep not over me, but hasten and bring my father to me; and ye see that it is my mouth that speaketh and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: For behold this is the second year of the famine, and there are still five years without harvest or fruit of trees or ploughing.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: Come down quickly ye and your households, so that ye perish not through the famine, and do not be grieved for your possessions, for the Lord sent me before you to set things in order that many people might live.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And tell my father that I am still alive, and ye, behold, ye see that the Lord hath made me as a father to Pharaoh, and ruler over his house and over all the land of Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And tell my father of all my glory, and all the riches and glory that the Lord hath given Me.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And by the command of the mouth of Pharaoh he gave them chariots and provisions for the way, and he gave them all many-coloured raiment and silver.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And to their father he sent raiment and silver and ten asses which carried com, and he sent them away.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And they went up and told their father that Joseph was alive, and was measuring out corn to all the nations of the earth, and that he was ruler over all the land of Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Finally Tests His Brethren, And Then Makes Himself Known To Them
book_of_jubilees.t: And their father did not believe it, for he was beside himself in his mind; but when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent, the life of his spirit revived, and he said: “It is enough for me if Joseph liveth; I will go down and see him before I die.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And Israel took his journey from †Haran† from his house on the new moon of the third month, and he went on the way of the Well of the Oath, and he offered a sacrifice to the God of his father Isaac on the seventh of this month.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And Jacob remembered the dream that he had seen at Bethel, and he feared to go down into Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And while he was thinking of sending word to Joseph to come to him, and that he would not go down, he remained there seven days, if perchance he should see a vision as to whether he should remain or go down.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And he celebrated the harvest festival of the first-fruits with old grain, for in all the land of Canaan there was not a handful of seed (in the land), for the famine was over all the beasts and cattle and birds, and also over man.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And on the sixteenth the Lord appeared unto him, and said unto him, “Jacob, Jacob”; and he said, “Here am I.” And He said unto him: “I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham and Isaac; fear not to go down into Egypt, for I will there make of thee a great nation.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: I shall go down with thee, and I shall bring thee up (again), and in this land wilt thou be buried, and Joseph will put his hands upon thy eyes. Fear not; go down into Egypt. ”

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And his sons rose up, and his sons’ sons, and they placed their father and their possessions upon wagons.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And Israel rose up from the Well of the Oath on the sixteenth of this third month, and he went to the land of Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And Israel sent Judah before him to his son Joseph to examine the Land of Goshen, for Joseph had told his brothers that they should come and dwell there that they might be near him.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And this was the goodliest (land) in the land of Egypt, and near to him, for all (of them) and also for the cattle.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And these are the names of the sons of Jacob who went into Egypt with Jacob their father.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: Reuben, the first-born of Israel; and these are the names of his sons: Enoch, and Pallu, and Hezron and Carmi--five.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: Simeon and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of the Zephathite woman--seven.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: Levi and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari--four.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: Judah and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Shela, and Perez, and Zerah--four.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: Issachar and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Tola, and Phûa, and Jâsûb, and Shimron--five.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: Zebulon and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel--four.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And these are the sons of Jacob, and their sons, whom Leah bore to Jacob in Mesopotamia, six, and their one sister, Dinah: and all the souls of the sons of Leah, and their sons, who went with Jacob their father into Egypt, were twenty-nine, and Jacob their father being with them, they were thirty.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, the wife of Jacob, whom she bore unto Jacob, Gad and Asher.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And these are the names of their sons who went with him into Egypt: the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, and Shuni, and Ezbon, (and Eri) and Areli, and Arodi--eight.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, (and Ishvi), and Beriah, and Serah, their one sister--six.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: All the souls were fourteen, and all those of Leah were forty-four.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Rachel, the wife of Jacob: Joseph and Benjamin.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And there were born to Joseph in Egypt before his father came into Egypt, those whom Asenath, daughter of Potiphar priest of Heliopolis bare unto him, Manasseh, and Ephraim--three.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, and Ehi, and Rosh, and Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard--eleven.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the souls of Rachel were fourteen.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And the sons of Bilhah, the handmaid of Rachel, the wife of Jacob, whom she bare to Jacob, were Dan and Naphtali.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And these are the names of their sons who went with them into Egypt. And the sons of Dan were Hushim, and Sâmôn, and Asûdî, and ‘Îjâka, and Salômôn--six.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And they died the year in which they entered into Egypt, and there was left to Dan Hushim alone.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And these are the names of the sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, and ‘Îv.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And ‘Îv, who was born after the years of famine, died in Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the souls of Rachel were twenty-six.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And all the souls of Jacob which went into Egypt were seventy souls. These are his children and his children’s children, in all seventy; but five died in Egypt before Joseph, and had no children.

book_of_jubilees.title: Jacob, Celebrates The Feast Of First-Fruits And Journeys To Egypt. List Of His Descendants
book_of_jubilees.t: And in the land of Canaan two sons of Judah died, Er and Onan, and they had no children, and the children of Israel buried those who perished, and they were reckoned among the seventy Gentile nations.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: (2172 A M.) And Israel went into the country of Egypt, into the land of Goshen, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the second year of the third week of the forty-fifth jubilee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph went to meet his father Jacob, to the land of Goshen, and he fell on his father’s neck and wept.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And Israel said unto Joseph: “Now let me die since I have seen thee, and now may the Lord God of Israel be blessed, the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac who hath not withheld His mercy and His grace from His servant Jacob.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: It is enough for me that I have seen thy face whilst †I am† yet alive; yea, true is the vision which I saw at Bethel. Blessed be the Lord my God for ever and ever, and blessed be His name.”

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph and his brothers ate bread before their father and drank wine, and Jacob rejoiced with exceeding great joy because he saw Joseph eating with his brothers and drinking before him, and he blessed the Creator of all things who had preserved him, and had preserved for him his twelve sons.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph had given to his father and to his brothers as a gift the right of dwelling in the land of Goshen and in Rameses and all the region round about, which he ruled over before Pharaoh. And Israel and his sons dwelt in the land of Goshen, the best part of the land of Egypt; and Israel was one hundred and thirty years old when he came into Egypt,

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph nourished his father and his brethren and also their possessions with bread as much as sufficed them for the seven years of the famine.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And the land of Egypt suffered by reason of the famine, and Joseph acquired all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh in return for food, and he got possession of the people and their cattle and everything for Pharaoh.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And the years of the famine were accomplished, and Joseph gave to the people in the land seed and food that they might sow (the land) in the eighth year, for the river had overflowed all the land of Egypt.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: For in the seven years of the famine it had not overflowed and had irrigated only a few places on the banks of the river, but now it overflowed and the Egyptians sowed the land, and it bore much corn that year.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And this was the first year (2178 A.M.) of the fourth week of the forty-fifth jubilee.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And Joseph took of the corn of the harvest the fifth part for the king and left four parts for them for food and for seed, and Joseph made it an ordinance for the land of Egypt until this day.

book_of_jubilees.title: Joseph Receives Jacob. The Land Of Egypt Is Acquired For Pharaoh. Jacob’s Death And Burial
book_of_jubilees.t: And Israel lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and all the days which he lived were three jubilees, one hundred and forty-seven years, and he died in the fourth year (2188 A.M.) of the fifth week of the forty-fifth jubilee.
